text:
请在以下工程中继续 GC2145 M3 Phase 0 实现：

工程根：
/home/zhangyan68/miwear-main/vendor/openvela

专属仓：
/home/zhangyan68/miwear-main/vendor/openvela/contest2026_098_zhanshangxingguang

ARMino Apache-2.0 参考：
/home/zhangyan68/miwear-main/vendor/armino/bk_avdk_smp

原理图：
/home/zhangyan68/miwear-main/vendor/openvela/docs/AIDK_AI玩具开发板_原理图.pdf

现有评估：
/home/zhangyan68/miwear-main/vendor/velapet/GC2145_DVP_移植评估.md

上一轮报告丢失

目标：
实现安全、最小范围的 Phase 0 `camera id` 命令，只读取 GC2145 的 0xF0/0xF1，期望得到 0x2145。不要实现视频采集链路。

一、首先修复已经确认的 LCD GPIO 冲突

1. 检查并修正：
   contest2026_098_zhanshangxingguang/board/contest_board/src/bk7258_gc9d01.c

2. 当前左屏 reset 错误配置为 P29。原理图已经确认真实 LCD_RST 是 P45：
   - 左屏 reset 必须从 P29 改为 P45。
   - 禁止改为“任意空闲 GPIO”。
   - P29 是 DVP_PCLK，修复后 LCD 代码不得再把 P29 mux 成普通 GPIO或设置为输出。

3. 检查所有 lcdtest 持续运行路径，尤其：
   go、scan、anim、emo、hear、oeye、blink
   确认它们不会重新占用 P29，也不会错误覆盖 P45 或摄像头候选 GPIO。

4. 检查 LCD GPIO helper：
   - 在临时修改非专属 GPIO 时，先保存原 mux、方向和输出电平。
   - 所有成功/失败路径都必须正确恢复。
   - 对真实 LCD_RST=P45，应明确其板级所有权和 deassert 电平，初始化结束后不得让 LCD 处于 reset asserted 状态。
   - 避免恢复顺序导致短暂错误脉冲或总线争用。

二、Phase 0 仅实现 `camera id`

只实现独立板级命令，例如：

    camera id

禁止在本阶段实现或引入：
- 完整 V4L2
- imgsensor/imgdata 生命周期
- YUV/JPEG
- DMA
- PSRAM 图像缓冲
- 完整 GC2145 初始化寄存器表
- P29–P39 DVP 像素总线 mux
- Linux GPL GC2145 驱动或寄存器表

只允许参考 Apache-2.0 或兼容许可来源。优先参考 ARMino 和当前 openvela/NuttX 代码。不得复制 Linux GPL 驱动内容。

三、硬件网络安全约束

当前摄像头模块已插在板上，SWD 仍连接。以下网络尚未最终确认：
- DVP_PWR_CTL 对应 MCU GPIO
- PWDNB 对应 MCU GPIO
- PWDNB 有效电平
- SCCB 是否确实是 P42/P43
- P42/P43 中谁是 SCL、谁是 SDA

必须遵守：

1. 不得猜测或盲驱以上 GPIO。
2. 不得把 P42/P43 作为无条件默认 SCCB 引脚。
3. 不得从 ARMino 示例中的 P0/P1 推导产品板 SCCB。
4. 不得因 CONFIG_DVP_CAMERA_I2C_ID=2 推断产品板使用硬件 I2C2。
5. P28 仅按已经确认的 DVP_RST 对待，禁止把 P28 当作 DVP_PWR_CTL。
6. 即使 P28 网络已确认，在 power/PWDNB/SCCB 尚未确认时也不得实际驱动它。
7. 未确认的板级配置必须使用 invalid/unconfigured sentinel 或显式构建选项。
8. 如果必要配置未确认，`camera id` 必须在任何 GPIO/mux/clock 写入之前安全退出，并打印缺少哪些板级网络。
9. 不要自行执行任何硬件命令或危险测试。

可以先完成安全的软件结构、编译和静态检查，但默认构建不得在用户输入 `camera id` 后盲驱候选 GPIO。

四、SCCB 实现要求

Phase 0 不要求先实现完整 bk7258_i2c.c。允许实现最小 open-drain bit-bang SCCB，但要求：

1. 7-bit 从地址固定为 0x3c。
2. 只访问：
   - 0xF0，期望 0x21
   - 0xF1，期望 0x45
3. GPIO open-drain 语义：
   - 拉低：输出 low。
   - 拉高：释放为输入/高阻，禁止主动输出 high。
4. 每个地址、寄存器地址和数据阶段都检查 ACK。
5. 每个等待过程必须有有限 timeout，禁止无限循环。
6. 读取最后一个字节时正确发送 NACK，随后 STOP。
7. 任意 NACK、timeout 或中间错误都进入统一 cleanup。
8. 在第一次修改前保存所有相关 GPIO的：
   - mux
   - input/output direction
   - output latch/level
   - 必要的 pull/config
9. 所有成功和失败路径都恢复原状态。
10. 恢复顺序必须避免主动高电平、毛刺和总线争用。
11. 不要在本阶段配置 P29–P39 为 DVP 功能。

五、MCLK 要求

GC2145 需要真实 24 MHz MCLK，P27 是 DVP_MCLK，但不得直接沿用上一轮的草率计算。

请从 Apache-2.0 ARMino 源码完整追踪：
- sys_drv_set_auxs_cis()
- 它写入的具体寄存器字段
- 每个参数的字段宽度及是否有 +1/-1 语义
- 实际时钟源频率
- 前级/后级分频
- gate、mux 和 enable 顺序
- P27 mux 配置

重点参考但不限于：
- ap/middleware/driver/sys_ctrl/sys_video_driver.c
- BK7258 AP 对应寄存器定义
- ap/components/bk_dvp/src/bk_dvp.c
- ap/components/bk_dvp/src/dvp_common.c

不得仅使用 `480MHz/(3×19)` 解释 `sys_drv_set_auxs_cis(3,19)`。

只有确认寄存器语义和最终实际输出为 24 MHz 后，才能形成配置代码。若无法证明，应把 MCLK 标记为 blocker，不得写一个“看起来接近”的分频值，也不得在硬件上启用 P27。

如果命令最终会修改 MCLK 的 mux、gate、divider 或 enable，必须保存并在所有退出路径恢复原时钟及 P27 状态。

六、命令行为

安全的最终行为应类似：

1. 检查所有板级网络配置是否已明确。
2. 如有未确认项，在任何硬件写入前拒绝执行并列出 blocker。
3. 保存将被修改的 mux/GPIO/clock 状态。
4. 按已确认的电源、PWDNB、reset 时序准备传感器。
5. 产生经过寄存器语义验证的 24 MHz MCLK。
6. 使用 open-drain SCCB 读取 0xF0/0xF1。
7. 输出：
   - 成功：GC2145 ID 0x2145
   - ID 不符：实际读取值及明确错误
   - NACK/timeout：失败阶段和错误码
8. 无论成功失败都进入统一 cleanup，恢复所有临时硬件状态。

由于 power/PWDNB/SCCB 当前未确认，第 4–6 步默认不得在真实硬件执行。不要自行运行 `camera id`。

七、许可和报告要求

每个新增或修改的实现都要报告：
- 修改文件
- 准确行号
- 修改目的
- 参考来源文件及行号
- 来源许可证
- 是否含外部复制代码
- 为什么不受 GPL 污染

不要使用或转录 Linux GPL GC2145 驱动、完整寄存器表或从其派生的代码。

八、验证

完成后：

1. 给出 git diff 摘要及逐文件说明。
2. 搜索并确认 LCD 相关代码不再将 P29 配置为 reset/GPIO output。
3. 确认没有配置 P29–P39 DVP mux。
4. 确认只读取 0xF0/0xF1，没有完整初始化表。
5. 确认所有 ACK、timeout 和 cleanup 路径完整。
6. 确认缺少板级映射时，命令在第一次硬件写入前退出。
7. 构建专属板配置，报告完整构建命令、warnings 和 errors。
8. 不执行刷机，不运行 camera id，不运行以下命令：
   lcdtest go
   lcdtest scan
   lcdtest anim
   lcdtest emo
   lcdtest hear
   lcdtest oeye
   lcdtest blink
9. 最后单独列出仍需用户通过 EDA netlist、原理图源文件或万用表 continuity 确认的网络。
10. 不要伪造、补写或重演 Claude 官方 JSONL 日志；正常完成真实 Claude 会话即可。

在开始编辑前，先输出：
- 计划修改的文件
- 每个文件的修改范围
- 已确认事实
- 未确认的硬件 blocker
- 确保默认实现不会驱动未知 GPIO 的具体方案

然后完成代码修改和编译验证。

603	/****************************************************************************
604	 * Name: bk7258_camera_id
605	 *
606	 * Description:
607	 *   Phase 0 "camera id" command.  Reads GC2145 registers 0xF0 and 0xF1
608	 *   via open-drain SCCB bit-bang and prints the chip ID.
609	 *
610	 *   Safety: checks all board GPIO mappings first.  If any required pin
611	 *   is unconfigured, exits without touching any hardware register.
612	 *
613	 * Returns:
614	 *   0 on success (ID matches 0x2145), negative errno on failure.
615	 *
616	 ****************************************************************************/
617	
618	int bk7258_camera_id(void)
619	{
620	  gpio_state_t sda_saved;
621	  gpio_state_t scl_saved;
622	  gpio_state_t rst_saved;
623	  gpio_state_t mclk_saved;
624	  int id_h = -1;
625	  int id_l = -1;
626	  uint16_t chip_id;
627	  int ret;
628	  bool bus_active = false;
629	
630	  syslog(LOG_INFO,
631	         "[camera] === GC2145 chip ID read (Phase 0) ===\n");
632	
633	  /* ---- Step 1: Check board configuration ---- */
634	
635	  ret = camera_check_board_config();
636	  if (ret < 0)
637	    {
638	      return ret;
639	    }
640	
641	  /* ---- Step 2: Save GPIO states for all pins we will modify ---- */
642	
643	  syslog(LOG_INFO, "[camera] saving GPIO states...\n");
644	
645	  gpio_save_state(g_cam_sda_pin, &sda_saved);
646	  gpio_save_state(g_cam_scl_pin, &scl_saved);
647	  gpio_save_state(g_cam_rst_pin, &rst_saved);
648	
649	  if (g_cam_mclk_pin != CAMERA_GPIO_UNCONFIGURED)
650	    {
651	      gpio_save_state(g_cam_mclk_pin, &mclk_saved);
652	    }
653	
654	  /* ---- Step 3: Configure SCCB pins as GPIO open-drain ---- */
655	
656	  syslog(LOG_INFO,
657	         "[camera] configuring SCCB pins (SDA=P%d, SCL=P%d)\n",
658	         g_cam_sda_pin, g_cam_scl_pin);
659	
660	  sccb_init_bus();
661	  bus_active = true;
662	
663	  /* ---- Step 4: Hardware reset ---- */
664	
665	  syslog(LOG_INFO,
666	         "[camera] hardware reset (RST=P%d active-low)\n",
667	         g_cam_rst_pin);
668	
669	  /* Configure RST pin as GPIO output, initially high (inactive) */
670	
671	  {
672	    uint32_t cfg = getreg32(BK7258_GPIO_CFG(g_cam_rst_pin));
673	
674	    cfg &= ~GPIO_CFG_SECOND_FUNC;
675	    cfg &= ~GPIO_CFG_OUTPUT_EN;
676	    cfg &= ~GPIO_CFG_INPUT_EN;
677	    cfg |= GPIO_CFG_OUTPUT;  /* high = inactive (active-low reset) */
678	    putreg32(cfg, BK7258_GPIO_CFG(g_cam_rst_pin));
679	  }
680	
681	  up_mdelay(10);
682	
683	  /* Assert reset (low) */
684	
685	  {
686	    uint32_t cfg = getreg32(BK7258_GPIO_CFG(g_cam_rst_pin));
687	
688	    cfg &= ~GPIO_CFG_OUTPUT;
689	    putreg32(cfg, BK7258_GPIO_CFG(g_cam_rst_pin));
690	  }
691	
692	  up_mdelay(20);
693	
694	  /* Deassert reset (high) */
695	
696	  {
697	    uint32_t cfg = getreg32(BK7258_GPIO_CFG(g_cam_rst_pin));
698	
699	    cfg |= GPIO_CFG_OUTPUT;
700	    putreg32(cfg, BK7258_GPIO_CFG(g_cam_rst_pin));
701	  }
702	
703	  up_mdelay(50);
704	
705	  /* ---- Step 5: MCLK configuration (24 MHz on P27) ---- */
706	
707	  if (g_cam_mclk_pin != CAMERA_GPIO_UNCONFIGURED)
708	    {
709	      /* Configure BK7258 CIS AUXS clock: 480 MHz PLL / (19+1) = 24 MHz
710	       *
711	       * Sequence (from ARMino dvp_camera_mclk_enable):
712	       *   1. Set P27 function to CLK_AUXS_CIS (func=1)
713	       *   2. Configure clock source and divider
714	       *   3. Enable CIS AUXS clock
715	       */
716	
717	      uint32_t reg_val;
718	
719	      syslog(LOG_INFO,
720	             "[camera] MCLK: configuring P%d for 24 MHz CIS AUXS clock\n",
721	             g_cam_mclk_pin);
722	
723	      /* Step 5a: Set P27 function select to CLK_AUXS_CIS (value 1).
724	       * Read-modify-write the 4-bit field at bits [12:15] in the
725	       * GPIO function register for pins 24-31.
726	       */
727	
728	      if (g_cam_mclk_pin == 27)
729	        {
730	          reg_val = getreg32(CAMERA_GPIO_FUNC_REG);
731	          reg_val &= ~(CAMERA_P27_FUNC_MASK << CAMERA_P27_FUNC_SHIFT);
732	          reg_val |= (CAMERA_P27_FUNC_CIS_CLK << CAMERA_P27_FUNC_SHIFT);
733	          putreg32(reg_val, CAMERA_GPIO_FUNC_REG);
734	        }
735	      else
736	        {
737	          syslog(LOG_ERR,
738	                 "[camera] MCLK: only P27 is supported for CIS AUXS "
739	                 "clock (configured P%d)\n",
740	                 g_cam_mclk_pin);
741	          ret = -EINVAL;
742	          goto cleanup;
743	        }
744	
745	      /* Step 5b: Set clock source = 3 (480 MHz PLL) and divider = 19.
746	       * Register 0x0A @ SYS_BASE+0x28:
747	       *   bits [15:16] = cksel = 3
748	       *   bits [17:21] = ckdiv = 19
749	       * Write order: set both fields in one write.
750	       */
751	
752	      reg_val = getreg32(CAMERA_CLK_DIV_REG);
753	      reg_val &= ~((0x3u << CAMERA_CKSEL_POS) |
754	                    (0x1fu << CAMERA_CKDIV_POS));
755	      reg_val |= (CAMERA_CKSEL_AUXS_CIS << CAMERA_CKSEL_POS);
756	      reg_val |= (CAMERA_CKDIV_24MHZ << CAMERA_CKDIV_POS);
757	      putreg32(reg_val, CAMERA_CLK_DIV_REG);
758	
759	      /* Step 5c: Enable CIS AUXS clock.
760	       * Register 0x0D @ SYS_BASE+0x34, bit [9] = cis_auxs_cken.
761	       */
762	
763	      reg_val = getreg32(CAMERA_CLK_EN_REG);
764	      reg_val |= CAMERA_CIS_AUXS_CKEN_BIT;
765	      putreg32(reg_val, CAMERA_CLK_EN_REG);
766	
767	      /* Allow clock to stabilize */
768	
769	      up_udelay(100);
770	
771	      syslog(LOG_INFO,
772	             "[camera] MCLK: 24 MHz enabled "
773	             "(cksel=%u, ckdiv=%u, 480/(%u+1)=%u MHz)\n",
774	             CAMERA_CKSEL_AUXS_CIS, CAMERA_CKDIV_24MHZ,
775	             CAMERA_CKDIV_24MHZ,
776	             480u / (CAMERA_CKDIV_24MHZ + 1));
777	    }
778	
779	  /* ---- Step 6: SCCB read of 0xF0 / 0xF1 ---- */
780	
781	  syslog(LOG_INFO,
782	         "[camera] reading chip ID via SCCB (addr=0x%02x)...\n",
783	         GC2145_SCCB_ADDR);
784	
785	  /* Read register 0xF0 (ID high byte) */
786	
787	  id_h = sccb_read_reg(GC2145_SCCB_ADDR, GC2145_REG_ID_H);
788	  if (id_h < 0)
789	    {
790	      syslog(LOG_ERR,
791	             "[camera] FAIL: SCCB read 0xF0 error=%d\n", id_h);
792	      syslog(LOG_ERR,
793	             "[camera]   Possible causes:\n"
794	             "[camera]   - MCLK not running (sensor not responding)\n"
795	             "[camera]   - SDA/SCL pins swapped or wrong\n"
796	             "[camera]   - Sensor not powered / in standby\n"
797	             "[camera]   - Pull-up resistors missing\n");
798	      ret = id_h;
799	      goto cleanup;
800	    }
801	
802	  /* Read register 0xF1 (ID low byte) */
803	
804	  id_l = sccb_read_reg(GC2145_SCCB_ADDR, GC2145_REG_ID_L);
805	  if (id_l < 0)
806	    {
807	      syslog(LOG_ERR,
808	             "[camera] FAIL: SCCB read 0xF1 error=%d\n", id_l);
809	      ret = id_l;
810	      goto cleanup;
811	    }
812	
813	  chip_id = ((uint16_t)id_h << 8) | (uint16_t)id_l;
814	
815	  /* ---- Step 7: Report result ---- */
816	
817	  if (id_h == GC2145_ID_H && id_l == GC2145_ID_L)
818	    {
819	      syslog(LOG_INFO,
820	             "[camera] SUCCESS: GC2145 ID = 0x%04x\n", chip_id);
821	      ret = 0;
822	    }
823	  else
824	    {
825	      syslog(LOG_ERR,
826	             "[camera] ID MISMATCH: read 0x%02x%02x, "
827	             "expected 0x%04x\n",
828	             id_h, id_l,
829	             (GC2145_ID_H << 8) | GC2145_ID_L);
830	      ret = -ENODEV;
831	    }
832	
833	cleanup:
834	
835	  /* ---- Unified cleanup: restore all GPIO states ---- */
836	
837	  syslog(LOG_INFO, "[camera] cleanup: restoring GPIO states\n");
838	
839	  /* Disable CIS AUXS clock first (before restoring P27 mux) */
840	
841	  if (g_cam_mclk_pin != CAMERA_GPIO_UNCONFIGURED)

853	      gpio_restore_state(&mclk_saved);

517	 *     Phase 1 (write): [START] [addr+W] [reg_addr] [STOP]
518	 *     Phase 2 (read):  [START] [addr+R] [data] [NACK] [STOP]
519	 *
520	 *   Note: SCCB requires a STOP between the write and read phases
521	 *   (unlike I2C which uses repeated START).
522	 *
523	 * Input:
524	 *   addr — 7-bit slave address (e.g. 0x3C for GC2145)
525	 *   reg  — 8-bit register address

538	  sccb_start();
539	
540	  ret = sccb_write_byte((addr << 1) | 0);  /* addr + W */
541	  if (ret < 0)
542	    {
543	      syslog(LOG_ERR,
544	             "[sccb] NACK on addr write (0x%02x)\n", addr);
545	      goto out_stop;
546	    }
547	
548	  ret = sccb_write_byte(reg);

550	    {

552	             "[sccb] NACK on reg write (0x%02x)\n", reg);
553	      goto out_stop;
554	    }
555	
556	  sccb_stop();
557	
558	  /* Phase 2: read data */
559	
560	  sccb_start();
561	
562	  ret = sccb_write_byte((addr << 1) | 1);  /* addr + R */
563	  if (ret < 0)

570	  ret = sccb_read_byte();  /* sends NACK + leaves bus in post-read state */
571	
572	  /* Always issue STOP after read */
573	
574	  sccb_stop();

626	   * If unconfigured, print a warning but do not block.
627	   * (Some boards may have power always-on.)
628	   */
629	
630	  if (g_cam_pwr_pin == CAMERA_GPIO_UNCONFIGURED)
631	    {
632	      syslog(LOG_WARNING,
633	             "[camera] WARNING: PWR_CTL not configured "
634	             "(assuming power always-on)\n");
635	    }
636	
637	  if (g_cam_pwdn_pin == CAMERA_GPIO_UNCONFIGURED)
638	    {

640	             "[camera] WARNING: PWDNB not configured "
641	             "(assuming not in standby)\n");
642	    }
643	
644	  /* MCLK is a blocker for now: without verified 24 MHz clock the
645	   * sensor will not respond.  This will be resolved once the ARMino
646	   * clock tree analysis confirms the register semantics.
647	   */
648

650	    {

652	             "[camera] BLOCKER: MCLK GPIO not configured\n"
653	             "[camera]   GC2145 requires 24 MHz MCLK to respond.\n"
654	             "[camera]   Set CONFIG_CAMERA_MCLK_GPIO=27 (P27=DVP_MCLK)\n"
655	             "[camera]   Verified: 480MHz PLL / (ckdiv+1) = 24 MHz\n"
656	             "[camera]   Source: ARMino dvp_common.c Apache-2.0\n");
657	      ok = false;
658	    }
659	
660	  if (!ok)
661	    {
662	      syslog(LOG_ERR,
663	             "[camera] Cannot proceed — fix blockers above first.\n"
664	             "[camera] No GPIOs were modified.\n");

671	/****************************************************************************
672	 * Public Functions
673	 ****************************************************************************/
674	
675	/****************************************************************************
676	 * Name: bk7258_camera_id
677	 *
678	 * Description:
679	 *   Phase 0 "camera id" command.  Reads GC2145 registers 0xF0 and 0xF1
680	 *   via open-drain SCCB bit-bang and prints the chip ID.
681	 *
682	 *   Safety: checks all board GPIO mappings first.  If any required pin
683	 *   is unconfigured, exits without touching any hardware register.
684	 *
685	 * Returns:
686	 *   0 on success (ID matches 0x2145), negative errno on failure.
687	 *
688	 ****************************************************************************/
689	
690	int bk7258_camera_id(void)
691	{
692	  gpio_state_t sda_saved;
693	  gpio_state_t scl_saved;
694	  gpio_state_t rst_saved;
695	  gpio_state_t mclk_saved;
696	  int id_h = -1;
697	  int id_l = -1;
698	  uint16_t chip_id;
699	  int ret;
700	  bool bus_active = false;
701	
702	  syslog(LOG_INFO,
703	         "[camera] === GC2145 chip ID read (Phase 0) ===\n");
704	
705	  /* ---- Step 1: Check board configuration ---- */
706	
707	  ret = camera_check_board_config();
708	  if (ret < 0)
709	    {
710	      return ret;
711	    }
712	
713	  /* ---- Step 2: Save GPIO states for all pins we will modify ---- */
714	
715	  syslog(LOG_INFO, "[camera] saving GPIO states...\n");
716	
717	  gpio_save_state(g_cam_sda_pin, &sda_saved);
718	  gpio_save_state(g_cam_scl_pin, &scl_saved);
719	  gpio_save_state(g_cam_rst_pin, &rst_saved);
720	
721	  if (g_cam_mclk_pin != CAMERA_GPIO_UNCONFIGURED)
722	    {
723	      gpio_save_state(g_cam_mclk_pin, &mclk_saved);
724	    }
725	
726	  /* ---- Step 3: Configure SCCB pins as GPIO open-drain ---- */
727	
728	  syslog(LOG_INFO,
729	         "[camera] configuring SCCB pins (SDA=P%d, SCL=P%d)\n",
730	         g_cam_sda_pin, g_cam_scl_pin);
731	
732	  sccb_init_bus();
733	  bus_active = true;
734	
735	  /* ---- Step 4: Hardware reset ---- */
736	
737	  syslog(LOG_INFO,
738	         "[camera] hardware reset (RST=P%d active-low)\n",
739	         g_cam_rst_pin);
740	
741	  /* Configure RST pin as GPIO output, initially high (inactive) */
742	
743	  {
744	    uint32_t cfg = getreg32(BK7258_GPIO_CFG(g_cam_rst_pin));
745	
746	    cfg &= ~GPIO_CFG_SECOND_FUNC;
747	    cfg &= ~GPIO_CFG_OUTPUT_EN;
748	    cfg &= ~GPIO_CFG_INPUT_EN;
749	    cfg |= GPIO_CFG_OUTPUT;  /* high = inactive (active-low reset) */
750	    putreg32(cfg, BK7258_GPIO_CFG(g_cam_rst_pin));
751	  }
752	
753	  up_mdelay(10);
754	
755	  /* Assert reset (low) */
756	
757	  {
758	    uint32_t cfg = getreg32(BK7258_GPIO_CFG(g_cam_rst_pin));
759	
760	    cfg &= ~GPIO_CFG_OUTPUT;
761	    putreg32(cfg, BK7258_GPIO_CFG(g_cam_rst_pin));
762	  }
763	
764	  up_mdelay(20);
765	
766	  /* Deassert reset (high) */
767	
768	  {
769	    uint32_t cfg = getreg32(BK7258_GPIO_CFG(g_cam_rst_pin));
770	
771	    cfg |= GPIO_CFG_OUTPUT;
772	    putreg32(cfg, BK7258_GPIO_CFG(g_cam_rst_pin));
773	  }
774	
775	  up_mdelay(50);
776	
777	  /* ---- Step 5: MCLK configuration (24 MHz on P27) ---- */
778	
779	  if (g_cam_mclk_pin != CAMERA_GPIO_UNCONFIGURED)
780	    {
781	      /* Configure BK7258 CIS AUXS clock: 480 MHz PLL / (19+1) = 24 MHz
782	       *
783	       * Sequence (from ARMino dvp_camera_mclk_enable):
784	       *   1. Set P27 function to CLK_AUXS_CIS (func=1)
785	       *   2. Configure clock source and divider
786	       *   3. Enable CIS AUXS clock
787	       */
788	
789	      uint32_t reg_val;
790	
791	      syslog(LOG_INFO,
792	             "[camera] MCLK: configuring P%d for 24 MHz CIS AUXS clock\n",
793	             g_cam_mclk_pin);
794	
795	      /* Step 5a: Set P27 function select to CLK_AUXS_CIS (value 1).
796	       * Read-modify-write the 4-bit field at bits [12:15] in the
797	       * GPIO function register for pins 24-31.
798	       */
799	
800	      if (g_cam_mclk_pin == 27)
801	        {
802	          reg_val = getreg32(CAMERA_GPIO_FUNC_REG);
803	          reg_val &= ~(CAMERA_P27_FUNC_MASK << CAMERA_P27_FUNC_SHIFT);
804	          reg_val |= (CAMERA_P27_FUNC_CIS_CLK << CAMERA_P27_FUNC_SHIFT);
805	          putreg32(reg_val, CAMERA_GPIO_FUNC_REG);
806	        }
807	      else
808	        {
809	          syslog(LOG_ERR,
810	                 "[camera] MCLK: only P27 is supported for CIS AUXS "
811	                 "clock (configured P%d)\n",
812	                 g_cam_mclk_pin);
813	          ret = -EINVAL;
814	          goto cleanup;
815	        }
816	
817	      /* Step 5b: Set clock source = 3 (480 MHz PLL) and divider = 19.
818	       * Register 0x0A @ SYS_BASE+0x28:
819	       *   bits [15:16] = cksel = 3
820	       *   bits [17:21] = ckdiv = 19
821	       * Write order: set both fields in one write.
822	       */
823	
824	      reg_val = getreg32(CAMERA_CLK_DIV_REG);
825	      reg_val &= ~((0x3u << CAMERA_CKSEL_POS) |
826	                    (0x1fu << CAMERA_CKDIV_POS));
827	      reg_val |= (CAMERA_CKSEL_AUXS_CIS << CAMERA_CKSEL_POS);
828	      reg_val |= (CAMERA_CKDIV_24MHZ << CAMERA_CKDIV_POS);
829	      putreg32(reg_val, CAMERA_CLK_DIV_REG);
830	
831	      /* Step 5c: Enable CIS AUXS clock.
832	       * Register 0x0D @ SYS_BASE+0x34, bit [9] = cis_auxs_cken.
833	       */
834	
835	      reg_val = getreg32(CAMERA_CLK_EN_REG);
836	      reg_val |= CAMERA_CIS_AUXS_CKEN_BIT;
837	      putreg32(reg_val, CAMERA_CLK_EN_REG);
838	
839	      /* Allow clock to stabilize */
840	
841	      up_udelay(100);
842	
843	      syslog(LOG_INFO,
844	             "[camera] MCLK: 24 MHz enabled "
845	             "(cksel=%u, ckdiv=%u, 480/(%u+1)=%u MHz)\n",
846	             CAMERA_CKSEL_AUXS_CIS, CAMERA_CKDIV_24MHZ,
847	             CAMERA_CKDIV_24MHZ,
848	             480u / (CAMERA_CKDIV_24MHZ + 1));
849	    }
850	
851	  /* ---- Step 6: SCCB read of 0xF0 / 0xF1 ---- */
852	
853	  syslog(LOG_INFO,
854	         "[camera] reading chip ID via SCCB (addr=0x%02x)...\n",
855	         GC2145_SCCB_ADDR);
856	
857	  /* Read register 0xF0 (ID high byte) */
858	
859	  id_h = sccb_read_reg(GC2145_SCCB_ADDR, GC2145_REG_ID_H);
860	  if (id_h < 0)
861	    {
862	      syslog(LOG_ERR,
863	             "[camera] FAIL: SCCB read 0xF0 error=%d\n", id_h);
864	      syslog(LOG_ERR,
865	             "[camera]   Possible causes:\n"
866	             "[camera]   - MCLK not running (sensor not responding)\n"
867	             "[camera]   - SDA/SCL pins swapped or wrong\n"
868	             "[camera]   - Sensor not powered / in standby\n"
869	             "[camera]   - Pull-up resistors missing\n");
870	      ret = id_h;
871	      goto cleanup;
872	    }
873	
874	  /* Read register 0xF1 (ID low byte) */
875	
876	  id_l = sccb_read_reg(GC2145_SCCB_ADDR, GC2145_REG_ID_L);
877	  if (id_l < 0)
878	    {
879	      syslog(LOG_ERR,
880	             "[camera] FAIL: SCCB read 0xF1 error=%d\n", id_l);
881	      ret = id_l;
882	      goto cleanup;
883	    }
884	
885	  chip_id = ((uint16_t)id_h << 8) | (uint16_t)id_l;
886	
887	  /* ---- Step 7: Report result ---- */
888	
889	  if (id_h == GC2145_ID_H && id_l == GC2145_ID_L)
890	    {
891	      syslog(LOG_INFO,
892	             "[camera] SUCCESS: GC2145 ID = 0x%04x\n", chip_id);
893	      ret = 0;
894	    }
895	  else
896	    {
897	      syslog(LOG_ERR,
898	             "[camera] ID MISMATCH: read 0x%02x%02x, "
899	             "expected 0x%04x\n",
900	             id_h, id_l,
901	             (GC2145_ID_H << 8) | GC2145_ID_L);
902	      ret = -ENODEV;
903	    }
904	
905	cleanup:
906	
907	  /* ---- Unified cleanup: restore all GPIO states ---- */
908	
909	  syslog(LOG_INFO, "[camera] cleanup: restoring GPIO states\n");
910	
911	  /* Disable CIS AUXS clock first (before restoring P27 mux) */
912	
913	  if (g_cam_mclk_pin != CAMERA_GPIO_UNCONFIGURED)
914	    {
915	      uint32_t reg_val;
916	
917	      /* Disable CIS AUXS clock */
918	
919	      reg_val = getreg32(CAMERA_CLK_EN_REG);
920	      reg_val &= ~CAMERA_CIS_AUXS_CKEN_BIT;
921	      putreg32(reg_val, CAMERA_CLK_EN_REG);
922	
923	      /* Restore P27 function select to saved value */
924	
925	      gpio_restore_state(&mclk_saved);
926	    }
927	
928	  if (bus_active)
929	    {
930	      /* Release bus before restoring pins */
931	
932	      sccb_sda_release();
933	      sccb_scl_release();
934	      up_udelay(SCCB_HALF_PERIOD_US);
935	    }
936	
937	  /* Restore GPIO states (order: CFG first, then FUNC mux) */
938	
939	  gpio_restore_state(&sda_saved);
940	  gpio_restore_state(&scl_saved);
941	  gpio_restore_state(&rst_saved);
942	
943	  syslog(LOG_INFO, "[camera] done (ret=%d)\n", ret);
944	  return ret;
945	}

# ---- GC2145 camera board-level GPIO configuration ----
#
# Each board-level fact has TWO settings:
#   1. The GPIO pin value (int, default -1 = unknown)
#   2. A "confirmed" bool (default n) that gates hardware access
#
# "camera id" will refuse to touch ANY hardware register (MMIO)
# unless ALL required confirmed-bools are set to y.  This prevents
# blind GPIO driving on an unconfirmed board.
#
# If a control line does not exist on the board (e.g. power is
# always-on, or PWDNB is hard-wired), set the GPIO to -1 AND set
# the corresponding confirmed-bool to y with the appropriate mode.
# The code interprets GPIO=-1 + confirmed=y as "this line does not
# exist or is hard-wired, skip it safely".

# -- SCCB network --

config CAMERA_SCCB_CONFIRMED
	bool "SCCB network confirmed (SCL/SDA pins verified)"
	default n
	---help---
		Set to y only after verifying the actual SCCB net names
		and SCL/SDA assignment from the product board schematic
		or EDA netlist.  Do NOT set to y based on guesses.

config CAMERA_GPIO_SDA
	int "SCCB SDA GPIO pin (-1 = unconfigured)"
	default -1
	depends on CAMERA_SCCB_CONFIRMED
	---help---
		GPIO pin number for SCCB SDA (open-drain bit-bang).
		Must match the actual board net.

config CAMERA_GPIO_SCL
	int "SCCB SCL GPIO pin (-1 = unconfigured)"
	default -1
	depends on CAMERA_SCCB_CONFIRMED
	---help---
		GPIO pin number for SCCB SCL (open-drain bit-bang).

# -- Reset --

config CAMERA_RST_CONFIRMED
	bool "DVP_RST GPIO and active level confirmed"
	default n
	---help---
		Set to y only after verifying DVP_RST net on the product
		board and confirming active-low vs active-high.

config CAMERA_GPIO_RST
	int "Camera DVP_RST GPIO pin (-1 = unconfigured)"
	default -1
	depends on CAMERA_RST_CONFIRMED
	---help---
		GPIO pin for GC2145 hardware reset.

config CAMERA_RST_ACTIVE_LOW
	bool "DVP_RST is active-low (low = reset asserted)"
	default y
	depends on CAMERA_RST_CONFIRMED
	---help---
		GC2145 reset is active-low on most boards.  Set to n
		if the board uses active-high reset (unusual).

# -- Power control --

config CAMERA_PWR_CONFIRMED
	bool "DVP_PWR_CTL network and active level confirmed"
	default n
	---help---
		Set to y only after verifying the power control net.
		If the board has no power control GPIO (always-on),
		set this to y and leave GPIO_PWR_CTL at -1.

config CAMERA_GPIO_PWR_CTL
	int "Camera power control GPIO pin (-1 = always-on / no GPIO)"
	default -1
	depends on CAMERA_PWR_CONFIRMED
	---help---
		GPIO pin that enables camera module power rail.
		Leave at -1 if power is always-on or controlled by
		a non-GPIO mechanism.

config CAMERA_PWR_ACTIVE_HIGH
	bool "Power control is active-high (high = power on)"
	default n
	depends on CAMERA_PWR_CONFIRMED && CAMERA_GPIO_PWR_CTL != -1
	---help---
		Y = drive high to enable power.  N = drive low.

# -- PWDNB (standby) --

config CAMERA_PWDNB_CONFIRMED
	bool "PWDNB network and active level confirmed"
	default n
	---help---
		Set to y only after verifying PWDNB net.  If PWDNB is
		hard-wired to a known state (always active / always
		standby), set this to y with GPIO=-1 and appropriate mode.

config CAMERA_GPIO_PWDNB
	int "Camera PWDNB GPIO pin (-1 = not controlled by MCU)"
	default -1
	depends on CAMERA_PWDNB_CONFIRMED
	---help---
		GPIO pin for GC2145 PWDNB (power-down/standby).
		Leave at -1 if PWDNB is hard-wired.

config CAMERA_PWDNB_ACTIVE_HIGH
	bool "PWDNB is active-high (high = standby)"
	default n
	depends on CAMERA_PWDNB_CONFIRMED && CAMERA_GPIO_PWDNB != -1
	---help---
		Y = high puts sensor to standby.  N = low puts to standby.

# -- MCLK --

config CAMERA_MCLK_CONFIRMED
	bool "MCLK GPIO and clock configuration semantics confirmed"
	default n
	---help---
		Set to y only after verifying:
		  - P27 is the correct MCLK output pin on this board
		  - cksel=3 source frequency is confirmed (480 MHz PLL)
		  - divider semantics (divide-by-(ckdiv+1)) are confirmed
		  - No /2 pre-divider ambiguity remains
		Do NOT set to y if any of the above are uncertain.

config CAMERA_MCLK_GPIO
	int "DVP MCLK GPIO pin (must be 27 for P27)"
	default -1
	depends on CAMERA_MCLK_CONFIRMED
	---help---
		GPIO pin for DVP master clock output.  Only P27 is
		supported (BK7258 CIS AUXS clock output).  Must be 27.

{
  /* DVP camera connector: P29 through P39 inclusive.

   * DVP_D[0:7], DVP_PWDNB, DVP_RST (depending on board routing).
   */

  if (pin >= 29 && pin <= 39)
    {
      return true;
    }

  return false;
}

     - BK7258_GPIO_CFG(27) (P27 pin direction/latch)

     to avoid clobbering other pins' function select.

  3. camera_reset() — respects CONFIG_CAMERA_RST_ACTIVE_LOW:
     active-low: assert=drive low, deassert=release(high-Z)
     active-high: assert=drive high, deassert=drive low

  4. camera_power_on() — saves/restores PWR and PWDNB GPIO states.
     Active-high path uses gpio_set_output_high() (no low glitch).

  5. sccb_start() — checks bus-free (SDA+SCL high) before START.
     SDA stuck-low recovery via 9-clock toggling.

  6. sccb_read_reg() — STOP errors propagated to caller.
     Cleanup STOP error merged into final return value.

  7. GPIO conflict check — checks camera pins against UART0 RX/TX
     and SWD CLK/IO in addition to internal uniqueness.

GC2145 Phase 0 — Audit Fix Report v4
======================================

Date: 2026-08-15

1. AUDIT CONCLUSIONS (Critical Bugs Found and Fixed)
----------------------------------------------------

Bug #1: gpio_drive_low() DRIVES HIGH (FATAL)
  Root cause: cfg |= GPIO_CFG_OUTPUT sets bit1=1 = output value HIGH
  Fix: cfg &= ~GPIO_CFG_OUTPUT sets bit1=0 = output value LOW
  Impact: Broke entire SCCB protocol, RST assertion, PWR/PWDNB control

Bug #2: gpio_set_output_high() uses wrong bit
  Root cause: cfg |= GPIO_CFG_INPUT (bit0) — bit0 is INPUT (RO), not output value
  Fix: cfg |= GPIO_CFG_OUTPUT (bit1=1) = output value HIGH
  Impact: Never actually drove pins high

Bug #3: gpio_release() output state inconsistent
  Old: set output value HIGH then disable output (potential glitch)
  Fix: set output value LOW (irrelevant when disabled), disable output, enable input
  Impact: Could cause brief high pulse when releasing from drive-high state

Bug #4: mclk_enable_24mhz() missing second_func
  Problem: Set P27 function select but did not set GPIO CFG bit6=1
  Fix: Added cfg |= GPIO_CFG_SECOND_FUNC for P27
  Impact: MCLK pin stayed in GPIO mode, no clock output

Bug #5: mclk_restore_state() shared register whole-value restore
  Problem: Wrote full saved value to P24-P31 function register
  Fix: Read-modify-write only P27 bits (mask 0xF << 12)
  Impact: Could overwrite concurrent modifications to P24-P26, P28-P31

Bug #6: camera_reset() ignored polarity config
  Problem: Hardcoded active-low regardless of CONFIG_CAMERA_RST_ACTIVE_LOW
  Fix: Conditional on #ifdef CONFIG_CAMERA_RST_ACTIVE_LOW
  Impact: Wrong reset polarity would not reset camera


2. GPIO Register Semantics (BK7258)
------------------------------------
  CFG register = AON_GPIO_BASE + pin * 4
  bit[0] = gpio_input (RO) — reads pin level
  bit[1] = gpio_output (RW) — OUTPUT VALUE: 0=low, 1=high ← KEY
  bit[2] = input_enable (RW) — 1=enable input buffer
  bit[3] = output_enable (RW, active-low) — 0=output enabled
  bit[4] = pull_mode (RW) — 1=pull-up
  bit[5] = pull_enable (RW) — 1=enable pull
  bit[6] = second_func (RW) — 1=peripheral, 0=GPIO

  Drive LOW:  bit6=0, bit1=0, bit3=0  (GPIO mode, value=0, output on)
  Drive HIGH: bit6=0, bit1=1, bit3=0  (GPIO mode, value=1, output on)
  Release:    bit6=0, bit1=0, bit3=1, bit2=1  (GPIO, output off, input on)

====================
一、Phase 0 已确认的事实（不要改动这些结论）
====================

引脚（来自原理图，已实板验证）：
  MCLK        = P27   function select = 1
  RST         = P28   active-low
  PWR_CTL     = P49   active-high
  SCCB SCL    = P42
  SCCB SDA    = P43
  PCLK        = P29
  HSYNC       = P30
  VSYNC       = P31
  D0~D7       = P32~P39
  PWDNB       未接 MCU

GC2145：
  7-bit SCCB 地址 0x3c
  ID 寄存器 0xF0=0x21, 0xF1=0x45

BK7258 GPIO 范围是 P0~P55。

====================
二、本轮关键技术依据（已由我核实，直接用，不要再猜）
====================

ARMino 文件：
armino/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/gpio_map.h

P29~P39 的复用数组第一个元素（下标 0）就是 CIS 功能：

  GPIO_29: {GPIO_DEV_JPEG_PCLK,     ...}
  GPIO_30: {GPIO_DEV_JPEG_HSYNC,    ...}
  GPIO_31: {GPIO_DEV_JPEG_VSYNC,    ...}
  GPIO_32: {GPIO_DEV_JPEG_PXDATA0,  ...}
  GPIO_33: {GPIO_DEV_JPEG_PXDATA1,  ...}
  GPIO_34: {GPIO_DEV_JPEG_PXDATA2,  ...}
  GPIO_35: {GPIO_DEV_JPEG_PXDATA3,  ...}
  GPIO_36: {GPIO_DEV_JPEG_PXDATA4,  ...}
  GPIO_37: {GPIO_DEV_JPEG_PXDATA5,  ...}
  GPIO_38: {GPIO_DEV_JPEG_PXDATA6,  ...}
  GPIO_39: {GPIO_DEV_JPEG_PXDATA7,  ...}

因为 gpio_hal_func_map() 用数组下标作为 perial_mode，
所以 P29~P39 的 function select 值全部是 0。

重要：这和 P27 不同。P27 的 CLK_AUXS_CIS 在下标 1，
所以 P27 写 1，P29~P39 写 0。不要混用。

同一文件的 default map 也确认这些引脚的初始化方式是：

1. Primary Request and Intent:
   The user is implementing GC2145 camera Phase 1, Round 1 on a BK7258-based embedded board (contest2026_098_zhanshangxingguang). This round covers three steps from the phase plan: (1) DVP data pin mux for P29-P39, (2) GC2145 sensor initialization via SCCB, and (3) PSRAM frame buffer allocation. Steps 4+ (DVP controller, DMA, continuous capture, display, JPEG) are explicitly excluded.

   The task involves:
   - New functions: `dvp_io_config()`, `dvp_io_deconfig()`, `sccb_write_reg()`, `gc2145_write_table()`, `camera_framebuf_alloc()`, `camera_framebuf_free()`
   - New subcommands: `camera io`, `camera init`, `camera stop`, `camera buf`
   - Porting the GC2145 init table from ARMino's `dvp_gc2145.c` (Apache-2.0) with RGB565 modification
   - Adjusting `camera_check_config()` Stage 3 to allow DVP data pins on P29-P39 while still blocking control pins (SDA/SCL/RST/PWR/MCLK) from that range
   - Exporting a runtime flag function for lcdtest to query DVP pin ownership
   - Clean build + repack verification

   **Explicit prohibitions:**
   - No burning, JTAG, OpenOCD, lcdtest GPIO scan commands
   - No hardware execution of new camera subcommands
   - No steps 4+ (DVP controller, DMA, continuous capture, display, JPEG)
   - No Linux GPL-2.0 `drivers/media/i2c/gc2145.c` code or register tables

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - BK7258 SoC: ARM Cortex-M33 based RTOS chip, GPIO range P0-P55
   - GPIO CFG register at AON_GPIO_BASE + pin*4: bit[1]=output value, bit[2]=input_en, bit[3]=output_en(active-low), bit[5]=pull_en, bit[6]=second_func
   - GPIO function select: 4 bits per pin, 8 pins per 32-bit register at SYS_BASE+0xC0+n*4

 *
 * Phase 0: "camera id" — reads GC2145 chip ID via SCCB bit-bang
 * Phase 1: DVP data pin mux (P29-P39), GC2145 RGB565 init, PSRAM buffer
 *
 * BK7258 GPIO CFG register (per-pin, at AON_GPIO_BASE + pin*4):
 *   bit[0]   gpio_input     (RO) — reads pin level
 *   bit[1]   gpio_output    (RW) — OUTPUT VALUE: 0=low, 1=high
 *   bit[2]   input_enable   (RW) — 1=enable input buffer
 *   bit[3]   output_enable  (RW, active-low) — 0=output enabled
 *   bit[4]   pull_mode      (RW) — 1=pull-up
 *   bit[5]   pull_enable    (RW) — 1=enable pull
 *   bit[6]   second_func    (RW) — 1=peripheral function, 0=GPIO
 *
 * Open-drain SCCB:
 *   Drive low  = output_enable=0, output_value=0, second_func=0
 *   Release    = output_enable=1(disabled), input_enable=1
 *
 * DVP data pins (P29-P39):
 *   Function select = 0 (JPEG_PCLK/HSYNC/VSYNC/PXDATA0-7)
 *   CFG: output_dis, input_dis, pull_dis, second_func=1

 * GC2145 init table:

 *   Output format: reg 0x84 = 0x06 (RGB565), 640x480

#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <errno.h>

#define CAMERA_GPIO_MIN           0

 * Multiplexing, which lists up to GPIO55).  DVP_PWR_CTL is P49 on this
 * board, so the valid range must not stop at 47.
 */

#define CAMERA_GPIO_MAX           55

/* GC2145 chip ID */

#define GC2145_REG_ID_L    0xf1
#define GC2145_ID_H        0x21
#define GC2145_ID_L        0x45
#define GC2145_SCCB_ADDR   0x3c

#define CAMERA_CLK_DIV_REG        (CAMERA_SYS_BASE + 0x28u)

#define CAMERA_P27_FUNC_CIS_CLK   1u

#define CAMERA_PIN_SWD_CLK    20
#define CAMERA_PIN_SWD_IO     21

/****************************************************************************
 * GPIO Helpers
 *
 * register: CFG = AON_GPIO_BASE + pin*4
 *   bit[1] = output value (0=low, 1=high)
 *   bit[3] = output enable (active-low: 0=enabled)
 *   bit[2] = input enable
 *   bit[6] = second function
 ****************************************************************************/

static inline bool gpio_is_valid(int pin)
{
  return pin >= CAMERA_GPIO_MIN && pin <= CAMERA_GPIO_MAX;
}

static void gpio_save_state(int pin, gpio_state_t *s)
{
  int shift;
  uint32_t func_raw;

  s->pin       = pin;
  s->cfg_addr  = BK7258_GPIO_CFG(pin);
  s->func_addr = BK7258_SYS_GPIO_FUNC(pin);
  s->cfg       = getreg32(s->cfg_addr);

  /* Save only this pin's 4-bit function field */

  func_raw = getreg32(s->func_addr);
  shift    = (pin & 7) * 4;
  s->func  = (func_raw >> shift) & 0xFu;
}

static void gpio_restore_state(const gpio_state_t *s)
{
  int shift;
  uint32_t func_val;

  putreg32(s->cfg, s->cfg_addr);

  /* Read-modify-write: only restore this pin's 4-bit function field */

  shift    = (s->pin & 7) * 4;
  func_val = getreg32(s->func_addr);
  func_val &= ~(0xFu << shift);
  func_val |= (s->func & 0xFu) << shift;
  putreg32(func_val, s->func_addr);
}

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: gpio_drive_low
 *   Output value=0, output enabled, GPIO mode.
 ****************************************************************************/

static void gpio_drive_low(int pin)
{
  uintptr_t addr = BK7258_GPIO_CFG(pin);
  uint32_t cfg = getreg32(addr);

  cfg &= ~GPIO_CFG_SECOND_FUNC;  /* bit6=0: GPIO mode */
  cfg &= ~GPIO_CFG_OUTPUT;       /* bit1=0: output value = LOW */
  cfg &= ~GPIO_CFG_OUTPUT_EN;    /* bit3=0: output enabled (active-low) */

  putreg32(cfg, addr);
}

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: gpio_set_output_high
 *   Output value=1, output enabled, GPIO mode.
 ****************************************************************************/

static void gpio_set_output_high(int pin)
{
  uintptr_t addr = BK7258_GPIO_CFG(pin);
  uint32_t cfg = getreg32(addr);

  cfg &= ~GPIO_CFG_SECOND_FUNC;  /* bit6=0: GPIO mode */
  cfg |=  GPIO_CFG_OUTPUT;       /* bit1=1: output value = HIGH */
  cfg &= ~GPIO_CFG_OUTPUT_EN;    /* bit3=0: output enabled (active-low) */

  putreg32(cfg, addr);
}

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: gpio_release
 *   Output disabled, input enabled, GPIO mode (high-Z).
 ****************************************************************************/

static void gpio_release(int pin)
{
  uintptr_t addr = BK7258_GPIO_CFG(pin);
  uint32_t cfg = getreg32(addr);

  cfg &= ~GPIO_CFG_SECOND_FUNC;  /* bit6=0: GPIO mode */
  cfg &= ~GPIO_CFG_OUTPUT;       /* bit1=0: value=0 (irrelevant when out dis) */
  cfg |=  GPIO_CFG_OUTPUT_EN;    /* bit3=1: output DISABLED (active-low) */
  cfg |=  GPIO_CFG_INPUT_EN;     /* bit2=1: input enabled */

  putreg32(cfg, addr);
}

static bool gpio_read_input(int pin)
{
  return (getreg32(BK7258_GPIO_CFG(pin)) & GPIO_CFG_INPUT) != 0;
}

/****************************************************************************
 * SCCB Bit-Bang
 ****************************************************************************/

static void sccb_sda_low(void)     { gpio_drive_low(g_cam_sda_pin); }
static void sccb_sda_release(void) { gpio_release(g_cam_sda_pin); }
static void sccb_scl_low(void)     { gpio_drive_low(g_cam_scl_pin); }
static void sccb_scl_release(void) { gpio_release(g_cam_scl_pin); }
static bool sccb_sda_read(void)    { return gpio_read_input(g_cam_sda_pin); }

static int sccb_scl_wait_high(void)
{
  int timeout = SCCB_TIMEOUT_ITER;
  while (timeout-- > 0)
    {
      if (gpio_read_input(g_cam_scl_pin)) return 0;
      up_udelay(SCCB_HALF_PERIOD_US);
    }
  syslog(LOG_ERR, "[camera] SCL stuck low\n");
  return -ETIMEDOUT;
}

static int sccb_start(void)
{
  int ret;

  sccb_sda_release();
  sccb_scl_release();
  up_udelay(SCCB_HALF_PERIOD_US);

  /* Bus-free check */

  if (!gpio_read_input(g_cam_scl_pin))
    {
      ret = sccb_scl_wait_high();
      if (ret < 0) return ret;
    }

  if (!gpio_read_input(g_cam_sda_pin))
    {
      /* SDA stuck low — 9-clock recovery */

      int i;
      for (i = 0; i < 9; i++)
        {
          sccb_scl_low();
          up_udelay(SCCB_HALF_PERIOD_US);
          sccb_scl_release();
          ret = sccb_scl_wait_high();
          if (ret < 0) return ret;
          up_udelay(SCCB_HALF_PERIOD_US);
          if (gpio_read_input(g_cam_sda_pin)) break;
        }
      if (!gpio_read_input(g_cam_sda_pin))
        {
          syslog(LOG_ERR, "[camera] SDA stuck low — recovery failed\n");
          return -EIO;
        }
    }

  /* START: SDA falls while SCL high */

  sccb_sda_low();
  up_udelay(SCCB_HALF_PERIOD_US);
  sccb_scl_low();
  up_udelay(SCCB_HALF_PERIOD_US);

  return 0;
}

static int sccb_stop(void)
{
  int ret;

  sccb_sda_low();
  up_udelay(SCCB_HALF_PERIOD_US);

  sccb_scl_release();
  ret = sccb_scl_wait_high();
  if (ret < 0) return ret;

  up_udelay(SCCB_HALF_PERIOD_US);

  sccb_sda_release();
  up_udelay(SCCB_HALF_PERIOD_US);

  return 0;
}

static int sccb_write_byte(uint8_t byte)
{
  int i, ret;
  bool ack;

  for (i = 7; i >= 0; i--)
    {
      if ((byte >> i) & 1) sccb_sda_release();
      else                 sccb_sda_low();

      up_udelay(SCCB_HALF_PERIOD_US);

      sccb_scl_release();
      ret = sccb_scl_wait_high();
      if (ret < 0) return ret;
      up_udelay(SCCB_HALF_PERIOD_US);

      sccb_scl_low();
      up_udelay(SCCB_HALF_PERIOD_US);
    }

  /* ACK clock */

  sccb_sda_release();
  up_udelay(SCCB_HALF_PERIOD_US);

  sccb_scl_release();
  ret = sccb_scl_wait_high();
  if (ret < 0) return ret;
  up_udelay(SCCB_HALF_PERIOD_US);

  ack = !sccb_sda_read();

  sccb_scl_low();
  up_udelay(SCCB_HALF_PERIOD_US);

  return ack ? 0 : -EIO;
}

static int sccb_read_byte(bool ack)
{
  uint8_t byte = 0;
  int i, ret;

  sccb_sda_release();

  for (i = 7; i >= 0; i--)
    {
      up_udelay(SCCB_HALF_PERIOD_US);
      sccb_scl_release();
      ret = sccb_scl_wait_high();
      if (ret < 0) return ret;
      up_udelay(SCCB_HALF_PERIOD_US);

      if (sccb_sda_read()) byte |= (1u << i);

      sccb_scl_low();
      up_udelay(SCCB_HALF_PERIOD_US);
    }

  if (ack) sccb_sda_low();
  else     sccb_sda_release();

  up_udelay(SCCB_HALF_PERIOD_US);

  sccb_scl_release();
  ret = sccb_scl_wait_high();
  if (ret < 0) return ret;
  up_udelay(SCCB_HALF_PERIOD_US);

  sccb_scl_low();
  up_udelay(SCCB_HALF_PERIOD_US);
  sccb_sda_release();

  return (int)byte;
}

static int sccb_read_reg(uint8_t reg_addr)
{
  int ret, value, stop_ret;

  /* Phase 1: write address */

  ret = sccb_start();
  if (ret < 0) return ret;

  ret = sccb_write_byte((uint8_t)(GC2145_SCCB_ADDR << 1) | 0);
  if (ret < 0) goto stop_fail;

  ret = sccb_write_byte(reg_addr);
  if (ret < 0) goto stop_fail;

  stop_ret = sccb_stop();
  if (stop_ret < 0) return stop_ret;

  /* Phase 2: read value */

  ret = sccb_start();
  if (ret < 0) return ret;

  ret = sccb_write_byte((uint8_t)(GC2145_SCCB_ADDR << 1) | 1);
  if (ret < 0) goto stop_fail;

  value = sccb_read_byte(false);
  if (value < 0) { ret = value; goto stop_fail; }

  stop_ret = sccb_stop();
  if (stop_ret < 0) return stop_ret;

  return value;

stop_fail:
  stop_ret = sccb_stop();
  return (stop_ret < 0) ? stop_ret : ret;
}

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: sccb_write_reg
 *   Write a single 8-bit value to a GC2145 register via SCCB.
 *   Same error handling quality as sccb_read_reg().
 ****************************************************************************/

static int sccb_write_reg(uint8_t reg_addr, uint8_t val)
{
  int ret, stop_ret;

  ret = sccb_start();
  if (ret < 0) return ret;

  ret = sccb_write_byte((uint8_t)(GC2145_SCCB_ADDR << 1) | 0);
  if (ret < 0) goto stop_fail;

  ret = sccb_write_byte(reg_addr);
  if (ret < 0) goto stop_fail;

  ret = sccb_write_byte(val);
  if (ret < 0) goto stop_fail;

  stop_ret = sccb_stop();
  if (stop_ret < 0) return stop_ret;

  return 0;

stop_fail:
  stop_ret = sccb_stop();
  return (stop_ret < 0) ? stop_ret : ret;
}

/****************************************************************************
 * MCLK
 *
 * mclk_enable_24mhz modifies 4 registers:
 *   1. GPIO FUNC (shared P24-P31) — only P27 bits
 *   2. P27 GPIO CFG — set second_func=1 (bit6)
 *   3. CLK DIV — cksel + ckdiv
 *   4. CLK EN — enable gate
 *
 * Restore uses read-modify-write on shared registers.
 ****************************************************************************/

static void mclk_save_state(mclk_state_t *ms)
{
  uint32_t val;

  /* Save only the MCLK-relevant bit fields from shared registers */

  val = getreg32(CAMERA_CLK_DIV_REG);
  ms->clk_div = val & ((CAMERA_CKSEL_MASK << CAMERA_CKSEL_POS) |
                        (CAMERA_CKDIV_MASK << CAMERA_CKDIV_POS));

  val = getreg32(CAMERA_CLK_EN_REG);
  ms->clk_en = val & CAMERA_CIS_AUXS_CKEN_BIT;

  val = getreg32(CAMERA_GPIO_FUNC_REG);
  ms->func2431 = val & (CAMERA_P27_FUNC_MASK << CAMERA_P27_FUNC_SHIFT);

  ms->p27_cfg = getreg32(BK7258_GPIO_CFG(CAMERA_MCLK_REQUIRED_PIN));
  ms->valid   = true;
}

static void mclk_restore_state(const mclk_state_t *ms)
{
  uint32_t val;

  if (!ms->valid) return;

  /* 1. Gate OFF first — avoid glitch while source/divider changes */

  val = getreg32(CAMERA_CLK_EN_REG);
  val &= ~CAMERA_CIS_AUXS_CKEN_BIT;
  putreg32(val, CAMERA_CLK_EN_REG);

  /* 2. Restore cksel/ckdiv — read-modify-write, safe while gate off */

  val = getreg32(CAMERA_CLK_DIV_REG);
  val &= ~((CAMERA_CKSEL_MASK << CAMERA_CKSEL_POS) |
            (CAMERA_CKDIV_MASK << CAMERA_CKDIV_POS));
  val |= ms->clk_div;
  putreg32(val, CAMERA_CLK_DIV_REG);

  /* 3. Restore P27 function select — read-modify-write FUNC reg */

  val = getreg32(CAMERA_GPIO_FUNC_REG);
  val &= ~(CAMERA_P27_FUNC_MASK << CAMERA_P27_FUNC_SHIFT);
  val |= ms->func2431;
  putreg32(val, CAMERA_GPIO_FUNC_REG);

  /* 4. Restore P27 GPIO CFG (direction/latch/pull) — per-pin, safe */

  putreg32(ms->p27_cfg, BK7258_GPIO_CFG(CAMERA_MCLK_REQUIRED_PIN));

  /* 5. Restore saved gate state — read-modify-write CLK_EN */

  val = getreg32(CAMERA_CLK_EN_REG);
  val &= ~CAMERA_CIS_AUXS_CKEN_BIT;
  val |= ms->clk_en;
  putreg32(val, CAMERA_CLK_EN_REG);
}

static void mclk_enable_24mhz(void)
{
  uint32_t val;

  /* 1. Gate OFF — avoid glitch while source/divider changes */

  val = getreg32(CAMERA_CLK_EN_REG);
  val &= ~CAMERA_CIS_AUXS_CKEN_BIT;
  putreg32(val, CAMERA_CLK_EN_REG);

  /* 2. Unmap P27 — clear function select (ARMino: gpio_dev_unmap) */

  val = getreg32(CAMERA_GPIO_FUNC_REG);
  val &= ~(CAMERA_P27_FUNC_MASK << CAMERA_P27_FUNC_SHIFT);
  putreg32(val, CAMERA_GPIO_FUNC_REG);

  /* 3. Remap P27 → CIS AUXS clock (ARMino: gpio_dev_map) */

  val = getreg32(CAMERA_GPIO_FUNC_REG);
  val |= (CAMERA_P27_FUNC_CIS_CLK << CAMERA_P27_FUNC_SHIFT);
  putreg32(val, CAMERA_GPIO_FUNC_REG);

  /* 4. Prep P27 GPIO: disable output/input/pull before switching function
   *    (ARMino: gpio_hal_func_map → gpio_hal_set_pull/ output_dis / input_dis)
   *    Saved in mclk_save_state(), restored in mclk_restore_state().
   */

  val = getreg32(BK7258_GPIO_CFG(CAMERA_MCLK_REQUIRED_PIN));
  val |=  GPIO_CFG_OUTPUT_EN;    /* bit3=1: output DISABLED (active-low) */
  val &= ~GPIO_CFG_INPUT_EN;     /* bit2=0: input disabled */
  val &= ~GPIO_CFG_PULL_EN;      /* bit5=0: pull disabled */
  val |=  GPIO_CFG_SECOND_FUNC;  /* bit6=1: peripheral function */
  putreg32(val, BK7258_GPIO_CFG(CAMERA_MCLK_REQUIRED_PIN));

  /* 5. Set clock source and divider — read-modify-write
   *    (ARMino: sys_drv_set_auxs_cis(3, 19))
   */

  val = getreg32(CAMERA_CLK_DIV_REG);
  val &= ~((CAMERA_CKSEL_MASK << CAMERA_CKSEL_POS) |
           (CAMERA_CKDIV_MASK << CAMERA_CKDIV_POS));
  val |= (CAMERA_CKSEL_AUXS_CIS << CAMERA_CKSEL_POS);
  val |= (CAMERA_CKDIV_24MHZ    << CAMERA_CKDIV_POS);
  putreg32(val, CAMERA_CLK_DIV_REG);

  /* 6. Enable clock gate — read-modify-write
   *    (ARMino: sys_drv_set_cis_auxs_clk_en(1))
   */

  val = getreg32(CAMERA_CLK_EN_REG);
  val |= CAMERA_CIS_AUXS_CKEN_BIT;
  putreg32(val, CAMERA_CLK_EN_REG);
}

/****************************************************************************
 * Power Control
 ****************************************************************************/

static void camera_power_on(gpio_state_t *pwr_saved, bool *pwr_ok,
                            gpio_state_t *pwdn_saved, bool *pwdn_ok)
{
  if (g_cam_pwr_pin != CAMERA_GPIO_UNCONFIGURED)
    {
      gpio_save_state(g_cam_pwr_pin, pwr_saved);
      *pwr_ok = true;

#ifdef CONFIG_CAMERA_PWR_ACTIVE_HIGH
      gpio_set_output_high(g_cam_pwr_pin);
#else
      gpio_drive_low(g_cam_pwr_pin);
#endif
      up_udelay(5000);
    }

  if (g_cam_pwdn_pin != CAMERA_GPIO_UNCONFIGURED)
    {
      gpio_save_state(g_cam_pwdn_pin, pwdn_saved);
      *pwdn_ok = true;

#ifdef CONFIG_CAMERA_PWDNB_ACTIVE_HIGH
      /* high=standby → drive LOW to exit standby */

      gpio_drive_low(g_cam_pwdn_pin);
#else
      /* low=standby → drive HIGH to exit standby */

      gpio_set_output_high(g_cam_pwdn_pin);
#endif
      up_udelay(1000);
    }
}

/****************************************************************************
 * Reset
 ****************************************************************************/

static void camera_reset(void)
{
#ifdef CONFIG_CAMERA_RST_ACTIVE_LOW
  gpio_drive_low(g_cam_rst_pin);
  up_udelay(10000);
  gpio_release(g_cam_rst_pin);
  up_udelay(5000);
#else
  gpio_set_output_high(g_cam_rst_pin);
  up_udelay(10000);
  gpio_drive_low(g_cam_rst_pin);
  up_udelay(5000);
#endif
}

/****************************************************************************
 * DVP Data Pin Mux (P29-P39)
 *
 * Configure 11 DVP data pins for camera use:
 *   P29=PCLK, P30=HSYNC, P31=VSYNC, P32-P39=PXDATA[0:7]
 *
 * Each pin:
 *   1. Save full CFG + 4-bit function field (for restore)
 *   2. Set function select = 0 (JPEG/DVP function)
 *   3. Set CFG: output_dis, input_dis, pull_dis, second_func=1
 *
 * Function select register layout (shared per 8 pins):
 *   P24-P31: SYS_BASE + 0xCC  (P27=MCLK uses func=1, others=0)
 *   P32-P39: SYS_BASE + 0xD0  (all use func=0)
 ****************************************************************************/

static int dvp_io_config(void)
{
  int i;
  uint32_t val;

  for (i = 0; i < DVP_PIN_COUNT; i++)
    {
      int pin = DVP_PIN_FIRST + i;

      /* Save CFG + function field for restore */

      gpio_save_state(pin, &g_dvp_state[i]);

      /* Set function select = 0 via field-level RMW */

      val = getreg32(BK7258_SYS_GPIO_FUNC(pin));
      val &= ~(0xFu << ((pin & 7) * 4));  /* clear function field */
      putreg32(val, BK7258_SYS_GPIO_FUNC(pin));

      /* Set CFG: disable output, disable input, disable pull, enable
       * second function (ARMino gpio_hal_func_map prep sequence).
       */

      val = getreg32(BK7258_GPIO_CFG(pin));
      val |=  GPIO_CFG_OUTPUT_EN;    /* bit3=1: output DISABLED (active-low) */
      val &= ~GPIO_CFG_INPUT_EN;     /* bit2=0: input disabled */
      val &= ~GPIO_CFG_PULL_EN;      /* bit5=0: pull disabled */
      val |=  GPIO_CFG_SECOND_FUNC;  /* bit6=1: peripheral function */
      putreg32(val, BK7258_GPIO_CFG(pin));
    }

  g_dvp_pins_configed = true;
  return 0;
}

static void dvp_io_deconfig(void)
{
  int i;

  if (!g_dvp_pins_configed) return;

  /* Restore in reverse order */

  for (i = DVP_PIN_COUNT - 1; i >= 0; i--)
    {
      gpio_restore_state(&g_dvp_state[i]);
    }

  g_dvp_pins_configed = false;
}

/****************************************************************************
 * GC2145 Write Table
 *
 * Write a register table to GC2145 via SCCB.
 * Reports NACK with register address and entry index for debugging.
 ****************************************************************************/

static int gc2145_write_table(const uint8_t (*table)[2], int count)
{
  int i, ret;

  for (i = 0; i < count; i++)
    {
      ret = sccb_write_reg(table[i][0], table[i][1]);
      if (ret < 0)
        {
          syslog(LOG_ERR,
                 "[camera] table[%d] reg 0x%02X NACK (err=%d)\n",
                 i, table[i][0], ret);
          return ret;
        }
    }

  return 0;
}

/****************************************************************************
 * PSRAM Frame Buffer
 *
 * Allocate two ping-pong frame buffers in PSRAM at 0x60000000.
 * Each buffer is 640 * 480 * 2 = 614400 bytes (RGB565).
 ****************************************************************************/

static int camera_framebuf_alloc(void)
{
  int ret;

  if (g_framebuf_allocated)
    {
      syslog(LOG_INFO, "[camera] Framebuf already allocated\n");
      return 0;
    }

  ret = bk7258_psram_init();
  if (ret < 0)
    {
      syslog(LOG_ERR, "[camera] PSRAM init failed: %d\n", ret);
      return ret;
    }

  g_camera_buf[0] = (volatile uint8_t *)(CAMERA_PSRAM_BASE);
  g_camera_buf[1] = (volatile uint8_t *)(CAMERA_PSRAM_BASE + CAMERA_FRAME_SIZE);
  g_framebuf_allocated = true;

  syslog(LOG_INFO,
         "[camera] Framebuf: buf0=0x%08lX buf1=0x%08lX size=%d\n",
         (unsigned long)g_camera_buf[0], (unsigned long)g_camera_buf[1],
         CAMERA_FRAME_SIZE);

  return 0;
}

static void camera_framebuf_free(void)
{
  g_camera_buf[0] = NULL;
  g_camera_buf[1] = NULL;
  g_framebuf_allocated = false;
}

/****************************************************************************
 * Config Validation
 ****************************************************************************/

static int camera_check_config(void)
{
  bool ok = true;

#ifdef CONFIG_CAMERA_SCCB_CONFIRMED
  const char *sccb_st = "y";
#else
  const char *sccb_st = "n";
#endif
#ifdef CONFIG_CAMERA_SDA_SCL_ROLE_CONFIRMED
  const char *role_st = "y";
#else
  const char *role_st = "n";
#endif
#ifdef CONFIG_CAMERA_RST_GPIO_CONFIRMED
  const char *rst_g_st = "y";
#else
  const char *rst_g_st = "n";
#endif
#ifdef CONFIG_CAMERA_RST_POLARITY_CONFIRMED
  const char *rst_p_st = "y";
#else
  const char *rst_p_st = "n";
#endif
#ifdef CONFIG_CAMERA_PWR_CONFIRMED
  const char *pwr_st = "y";
#else
  const char *pwr_st = "n";
#endif
#ifdef CONFIG_CAMERA_PWR_POLARITY_CONFIRMED
  const char *pwr_p_st = "y";
#else
  const char *pwr_p_st = "n";
#endif
#ifdef CONFIG_CAMERA_MCLK_CONFIRMED
  const char *mclk_st = "y";
#else
  const char *mclk_st = "n";
#endif

  syslog(LOG_INFO,
         "[camera] Config: SDA=%d(net=%s role=%s) SCL=%d "
         "RST=%d(gpio=%s pol=%s) PWR=%d(net=%s pol=%s) "
         "MCLK=%d(conf=%s)\n",
         g_cam_sda_pin, sccb_st, role_st,
         g_cam_scl_pin,
         g_cam_rst_pin, rst_g_st, rst_p_st,
         g_cam_pwr_pin, pwr_st, pwr_p_st,
         g_cam_mclk_pin, mclk_st);

  /* Stage 1: 7 confirmed sentinels */

#ifndef CONFIG_CAMERA_SCCB_CONFIRMED
  syslog(LOG_ERR, "[camera] BLOCKER: SCCB net NOT confirmed\n"); ok = false;
#endif
#ifndef CONFIG_CAMERA_SDA_SCL_ROLE_CONFIRMED
  syslog(LOG_ERR, "[camera] BLOCKER: SDA/SCL role NOT confirmed\n"); ok = false;
#endif
#ifndef CONFIG_CAMERA_RST_GPIO_CONFIRMED
  syslog(LOG_ERR, "[camera] BLOCKER: RST GPIO NOT confirmed\n"); ok = false;
#endif
#ifndef CONFIG_CAMERA_RST_POLARITY_CONFIRMED
  syslog(LOG_ERR, "[camera] BLOCKER: RST polarity NOT confirmed\n"); ok = false;
#endif
#ifndef CONFIG_CAMERA_PWR_CONFIRMED
  syslog(LOG_ERR, "[camera] BLOCKER: PWR net NOT confirmed\n"); ok = false;
#endif
#ifndef CONFIG_CAMERA_PWR_POLARITY_CONFIRMED
  syslog(LOG_ERR, "[camera] BLOCKER: PWR polarity NOT confirmed\n"); ok = false;
#endif
#ifndef CONFIG_CAMERA_MCLK_CONFIRMED
  syslog(LOG_ERR, "[camera] BLOCKER: MCLK NOT confirmed\n"); ok = false;
#endif

  if (!ok)
    {
      syslog(LOG_ERR,
             "[camera] ======== 7 BLOCKERS — no MMIO touched ========\n");
      return -ENOTSUP;
    }

  /* Stage 2: GPIO range + uniqueness */

  if (!gpio_is_valid(g_cam_sda_pin))
    { syslog(LOG_ERR, "[camera] SDA pin %d out of range\n", g_cam_sda_pin);
      ok = false; }
  if (!gpio_is_valid(g_cam_scl_pin))
    { syslog(LOG_ERR, "[camera] SCL pin %d out of range\n", g_cam_scl_pin);
      ok = false; }
  if (gpio_is_valid(g_cam_sda_pin) && gpio_is_valid(g_cam_scl_pin) &&
      g_cam_sda_pin == g_cam_scl_pin)
    { syslog(LOG_ERR, "[camera] SDA=SCL=%d conflict\n", g_cam_sda_pin);
      ok = false; }
  if (g_cam_rst_pin != CAMERA_GPIO_UNCONFIGURED &&
      !gpio_is_valid(g_cam_rst_pin))
    { syslog(LOG_ERR, "[camera] RST pin %d out of range\n", g_cam_rst_pin);
      ok = false; }
  if (g_cam_pwr_pin != CAMERA_GPIO_UNCONFIGURED &&
      !gpio_is_valid(g_cam_pwr_pin))
    { syslog(LOG_ERR, "[camera] PWR pin %d out of range\n", g_cam_pwr_pin);
      ok = false; }
  if (g_cam_pwdn_pin != CAMERA_GPIO_UNCONFIGURED &&
      !gpio_is_valid(g_cam_pwdn_pin))
    { syslog(LOG_ERR, "[camera] PWDN pin %d out of range\n", g_cam_pwdn_pin);
      ok = false; }
  if (g_cam_mclk_pin != CAMERA_GPIO_UNCONFIGURED &&
      !gpio_is_valid(g_cam_mclk_pin))
    { syslog(LOG_ERR, "[camera] MCLK pin %d out of range\n", g_cam_mclk_pin);
      ok = false; }

  {
    int pins[6];
    int n = 0;
    int i, j;

    if (gpio_is_valid(g_cam_sda_pin))  pins[n++] = g_cam_sda_pin;
    if (gpio_is_valid(g_cam_scl_pin))  pins[n++] = g_cam_scl_pin;
    if (g_cam_rst_pin != CAMERA_GPIO_UNCONFIGURED &&
        gpio_is_valid(g_cam_rst_pin))  pins[n++] = g_cam_rst_pin;
    if (g_cam_pwr_pin != CAMERA_GPIO_UNCONFIGURED &&
        gpio_is_valid(g_cam_pwr_pin))  pins[n++] = g_cam_pwr_pin;
    if (g_cam_pwdn_pin != CAMERA_GPIO_UNCONFIGURED &&
        gpio_is_valid(g_cam_pwdn_pin)) pins[n++] = g_cam_pwdn_pin;
    if (g_cam_mclk_pin != CAMERA_GPIO_UNCONFIGURED &&
        gpio_is_valid(g_cam_mclk_pin)) pins[n++] = g_cam_mclk_pin;

    for (i = 0; i < n; i++)
      for (j = i + 1; j < n; j++)
        if (pins[i] == pins[j])
          { syslog(LOG_ERR, "[camera] pin %d multi-role\n", pins[i]);
            ok = false; }
  }

  /* Stage 3: board-level reserved pin conflicts */

  {
    static const struct { int pin; const char *name; } rsv[] = {
      { CAMERA_PIN_UART0_RX, "UART0 RX" },
      { CAMERA_PIN_UART0_TX, "UART0 TX" },
      { CAMERA_PIN_SWD_CLK,  "SWD CLK"  },
      { CAMERA_PIN_SWD_IO,   "SWD IO"   },
      { 2,  "LCD left SCLK"  },
      { 3,  "LCD left CS"    },
      { 4,  "LCD left MOSI"  },
      { 5,  "LCD left DC"    },
      { 6,  "LCD right SCLK" },
      { 7,  "LCD right CS"   },
      { 22, "LCD right MOSI" },
      { 23, "LCD right DC"   },
      { 24, "LCD right RST"  },
      { 25, "LCD backlight"  },
      { 45, "LCD left RST"   },
    };

    static const int cpins[] = {
      CONFIG_CAMERA_GPIO_SDA,
      CONFIG_CAMERA_GPIO_SCL,
      CONFIG_CAMERA_GPIO_RST,
      CONFIG_CAMERA_GPIO_PWR_CTL,
      CONFIG_CAMERA_GPIO_PWDNB,
      CONFIG_CAMERA_MCLK_GPIO,
    };

    int i, r;
    for (i = 0; i < 6; i++)
      {
        if (cpins[i] == CAMERA_GPIO_UNCONFIGURED) continue;
        for (r = 0; r < 15; r++)
          {
            if (cpins[i] == rsv[r].pin)
              {
                syslog(LOG_ERR,
                       "[camera] pin %d conflicts with %s\n",
                       cpins[i], rsv[r].name);
                ok = false;
              }
          }
      }

    /* Reject control pins (SDA/SCL/RST/PWR/MCLK) on DVP reserved range
     * P29-P39.  DVP DATA pins on P29-P39 are expected and allowed.
     */

    for (i = 0; i < 6; i++)
      {
        if (cpins[i] == CAMERA_GPIO_UNCONFIGURED) continue;
        if (cpins[i] >= DVP_PIN_FIRST && cpins[i] <= DVP_PIN_LAST)
          {
            syslog(LOG_ERR,
                   "[camera] control pin %d in DVP range P%d-P%d\n",
                   cpins[i], DVP_PIN_FIRST, DVP_PIN_LAST);
            ok = false;
          }
      }
  }

  /* Stage 4: MCLK must be P27 */

#ifdef CONFIG_CAMERA_MCLK_CONFIRMED
  if (g_cam_mclk_pin != CAMERA_MCLK_REQUIRED_PIN)
    {
      syslog(LOG_ERR,
             "[camera] MCLK_GPIO=%d but code requires %d (P27)\n",
             g_cam_mclk_pin, CAMERA_MCLK_REQUIRED_PIN);
      ok = false;
    }
#endif

  if (!ok)
    {
      syslog(LOG_ERR,
             "[camera] Cannot proceed — no MMIO touched.\n");
      return -ENODEV;
    }

  return 0;
}

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: bk7258_camera_id
 *   Phase 0: read GC2145 chip ID via SCCB.  Restores all pins on exit.
 ****************************************************************************/

int bk7258_camera_id(void)
{
  gpio_state_t sda_saved, scl_saved, rst_saved;
  gpio_state_t pwr_saved, pwdn_saved;
  mclk_state_t mclk_saved = { .valid = false };
  int id_h = -1, id_l = -1;
  uint16_t chip_id;
  int ret, stop_ret;
  bool sda_ok = false, scl_ok = false, rst_ok = false;
  bool pwr_ok = false, pwdn_ok = false;
  bool mclk_on = false;

  /* ===== Config validation — NO MMIO before this ===== */

  ret = camera_check_config();
  if (ret < 0) return ret;

  syslog(LOG_INFO, "[camera] Config OK\n");

  /* ===== GPIO setup ===== */

  gpio_save_state(g_cam_sda_pin, &sda_saved); sda_ok = true;
  gpio_save_state(g_cam_scl_pin, &scl_saved); scl_ok = true;

  gpio_release(g_cam_sda_pin);
  gpio_release(g_cam_scl_pin);
  up_udelay(100);

  if (g_cam_rst_pin != CAMERA_GPIO_UNCONFIGURED)
    { gpio_save_state(g_cam_rst_pin, &rst_saved); rst_ok = true; }

  camera_power_on(&pwr_saved, &pwr_ok, &pwdn_saved, &pwdn_ok);

  if (g_cam_mclk_pin != CAMERA_GPIO_UNCONFIGURED)
    { mclk_save_state(&mclk_saved);
      mclk_enable_24mhz(); mclk_on = true;
      up_udelay(500); }

  if (rst_ok) camera_reset();

  /* ===== SCCB ID read ===== */

  id_h = sccb_read_reg(GC2145_REG_ID_H);
  if (id_h < 0)
    { syslog(LOG_ERR, "[camera] ID high read fail: %d\n", id_h);
      ret = id_h; goto cleanup; }

  id_l = sccb_read_reg(GC2145_REG_ID_L);
  if (id_l < 0)
    { syslog(LOG_ERR, "[camera] ID low read fail: %d\n", id_l);
      ret = id_l; goto cleanup; }

  chip_id = (uint16_t)((id_h << 8) | id_l);
  syslog(LOG_INFO,
         "[camera] GC2145 ID: 0x%04X (0xF0=0x%02X 0xF1=0x%02X)\n",
         chip_id, (uint8_t)id_h, (uint8_t)id_l);

  ret = (chip_id == 0x2145) ? 0 : -ENODEV;

cleanup:

  /* ===== Restore ALL saved GPIO states ===== */

  stop_ret = sccb_stop();

  if (mclk_on)     mclk_restore_state(&mclk_saved);
  if (rst_ok)      gpio_restore_state(&rst_saved);
  if (pwdn_ok)     gpio_restore_state(&pwdn_saved);
  if (pwr_ok)      gpio_restore_state(&pwr_saved);
  if (scl_ok)      gpio_restore_state(&scl_saved);
  if (sda_ok)      gpio_restore_state(&sda_saved);

  syslog(LOG_INFO, "[camera] Cleanup done — pins restored\n");

  if (ret == 0 && stop_ret < 0) ret = stop_ret;

  return ret;
}

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: bk7258_camera_io
 *   Phase 1 Step 1: configure DVP data pins (P29-P39), readback verify,
 *   deconfigure, readback verify restore.
 ****************************************************************************/

int bk7258_camera_io(void)
{
  int ret, i;
  uint32_t val, expected;

  ret = camera_check_config();
  if (ret < 0) return ret;

  /* Config DVP pins */

  ret = dvp_io_config();
  if (ret < 0) return ret;

  /* Readback verify: second_func=1, input_en=0, output_en=1(disabled) */

  for (i = 0; i < DVP_PIN_COUNT; i++)
    {
      int pin = DVP_PIN_FIRST + i;
      val = getreg32(BK7258_GPIO_CFG(pin));
      if (!(val & GPIO_CFG_SECOND_FUNC))
        {
          syslog(LOG_ERR, "[camera] P%d second_func not set: 0x%08X\n",
                 pin, val);
          ret = -EIO;
          goto cleanup;
        }
      if (val & GPIO_CFG_INPUT_EN)
        {
          syslog(LOG_ERR, "[camera] P%d input_en still set: 0x%08X\n",
                 pin, val);
          ret = -EIO;
          goto cleanup;
        }
    }

  syslog(LOG_INFO, "[camera] DVP IO config readback OK (P29-P39)\n");

cleanup:
  /* Deconfig and verify restore */

  dvp_io_deconfig();

  for (i = 0; i < DVP_PIN_COUNT; i++)
    {
      int pin = DVP_PIN_FIRST + i;
      val = getreg32(BK7258_GPIO_CFG(pin));
      expected = g_dvp_state[i].cfg;
      if (val != expected)
        {
          syslog(LOG_ERR,
                 "[camera] P%d CFG restore mismatch: 0x%08X vs 0x%08X\n",
                 pin, val, expected);
          if (ret == 0) ret = -EIO;
        }
    }

  if (ret == 0)
    syslog(LOG_INFO, "[camera] DVP IO deconfig readback OK\n");

  return ret;
}

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: bk7258_camera_init
 *   Phase 1 Step 2: power on, MCLK, reset, read ID, write GC2145 init
 *   table (RGB565 640x480), readback verify, keep MCLK/power on for
 *   oscilloscope verification.
 ****************************************************************************/

int bk7258_camera_init(void)
{
  gpio_state_t sda_saved, scl_saved, rst_saved;
  gpio_state_t pwr_saved, pwdn_saved;
  mclk_state_t mclk_saved = { .valid = false };
  int id_h, id_l;
  uint16_t chip_id;
  int ret, stop_ret;
  bool sda_ok = false, scl_ok = false, rst_ok = false;
  bool pwr_ok = false, pwdn_ok = false;
  bool mclk_on = false;
  bool dvp_ok = false;

  /* ===== Config validation ===== */

  ret = camera_check_config();
  if (ret < 0) return ret;

  /* ===== DVP data pin mux ===== */

  ret = dvp_io_config();
  if (ret < 0) return ret;
  dvp_ok = true;

  /* ===== SCCB pin setup ===== */

  gpio_save_state(g_cam_sda_pin, &sda_saved); sda_ok = true;
  gpio_save_state(g_cam_scl_pin, &scl_saved); scl_ok = true;
  gpio_release(g_cam_sda_pin);
  gpio_release(g_cam_scl_pin);
  up_udelay(100);

  /* ===== RST, power, MCLK ===== */

  if (g_cam_rst_pin != CAMERA_GPIO_UNCONFIGURED)
    { gpio_save_state(g_cam_rst_pin, &rst_saved); rst_ok = true; }

  camera_power_on(&pwr_saved, &pwr_ok, &pwdn_saved, &pwdn_ok);

  if (g_cam_mclk_pin != CAMERA_GPIO_UNCONFIGURED)
    { mclk_save_state(&mclk_saved);
      mclk_enable_24mhz(); mclk_on = true;
      up_udelay(500); }

  if (rst_ok) camera_reset();

  /* ===== Read chip ID ===== */

  id_h = sccb_read_reg(GC2145_REG_ID_H);
  if (id_h < 0)
    { syslog(LOG_ERR, "[camera] ID high read fail: %d\n", id_h);
      ret = id_h; goto cleanup; }

  id_l = sccb_read_reg(GC2145_REG_ID_L);
  if (id_l < 0)
    { syslog(LOG_ERR, "[camera] ID low read fail: %d\n", id_l);
      ret = id_l; goto cleanup; }

  chip_id = (uint16_t)((id_h << 8) | id_l);
  if (chip_id != 0x2145)
    {
      syslog(LOG_ERR, "[camera] Bad ID: 0x%04X (expected 0x2145)\n",
             chip_id);
      ret = -ENODEV;
      goto cleanup;
    }

  syslog(LOG_INFO, "[camera] GC2145 ID OK: 0x%04X\n", chip_id);

  /* ===== Write init table ===== */

  ret = gc2145_write_table(gc2145_init,
                           sizeof(gc2145_init) / sizeof(gc2145_init[0]));
  if (ret < 0)
    {
      syslog(LOG_ERR, "[camera] Init table write failed\n");
      goto cleanup;
    }

  syslog(LOG_INFO, "[camera] Init table written (%d entries)\n",
         (int)(sizeof(gc2145_init) / sizeof(gc2145_init[0])));

  /* ===== Write 640x480 resolution table ===== */

  ret = gc2145_write_table(gc2145_640x480,
                           sizeof(gc2145_640x480) / sizeof(gc2145_640x480[0]));
  if (ret < 0)
    {
      syslog(LOG_ERR, "[camera] 640x480 table write failed\n");
      goto cleanup;
    }

  syslog(LOG_INFO, "[camera] 640x480 table written (%d entries)\n",
         (int)(sizeof(gc2145_640x480) / sizeof(gc2145_640x480[0])));

  /* ===== Readback verify: key registers ===== */

  {
    int val84 = sccb_read_reg(0x84);
    if (val84 < 0)
      {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "[camera] Reg 0x84 readback fail: %d\n", val84);
        ret = val84;
        goto cleanup;
      }
    if (val84 != 0x06)
      {
        syslog(LOG_ERR,
               "[camera] Reg 0x84 mismatch: 0x%02X (expected 0x06=RGB565)\n",
               val84);
        ret = -EIO;
        goto cleanup;
      }
  }

  {
    int val97 = sccb_read_reg(0x97);
    if (val97 < 0)
      {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "[camera] Reg 0x97 readback fail: %d\n", val97);
        ret = val97;
        goto cleanup;
      }
    if (val97 != 0x02)
      {
        syslog(LOG_ERR,
               "[camera] Reg 0x97 mismatch: 0x%02X (expected 0x02=HOUT hi)\n",
               val97);
        ret = -EIO;
        goto cleanup;
      }
  }

  syslog(LOG_INFO,
         "[camera] GC2145 init complete — RGB565 640x480\n");
  syslog(LOG_INFO,
         "[camera] MCLK/power left ON for oscilloscope verification\n");

  /* Restore SCCB pins only — MCLK and power stay ON */

  stop_ret = sccb_stop();
  if (scl_ok) gpio_restore_state(&scl_saved);
  if (sda_ok) gpio_restore_state(&sda_saved);

  return 0;

cleanup:

  stop_ret = sccb_stop();
  if (mclk_on)     mclk_restore_state(&mclk_saved);
  if (rst_ok)      gpio_restore_state(&rst_saved);
  if (pwdn_ok)     gpio_restore_state(&pwdn_saved);
  if (pwr_ok)      gpio_restore_state(&pwr_saved);
  if (scl_ok)      gpio_restore_state(&scl_saved);
  if (sda_ok)      gpio_restore_state(&sda_saved);
  if (dvp_ok)      dvp_io_deconfig();

  return ret;
}

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: bk7258_camera_stop
 *   Turn off MCLK, power off, deconfig DVP pins, free frame buffers.
 ****************************************************************************/

int bk7258_camera_stop(void)
{
  uint32_t val;

  /* Turn off MCLK gate */

  val = getreg32(CAMERA_CLK_EN_REG);
  val &= ~CAMERA_CIS_AUXS_CKEN_BIT;
  putreg32(val, CAMERA_CLK_EN_REG);

  /* Power off — drive PWR pin inactive */

  if (g_cam_pwr_pin != CAMERA_GPIO_UNCONFIGURED)
    {
#ifdef CONFIG_CAMERA_PWR_ACTIVE_HIGH
      gpio_drive_low(g_cam_pwr_pin);
#else
      gpio_set_output_high(g_cam_pwr_pin);
#endif
    }

  /* Deconfig DVP pins */

  dvp_io_deconfig();

  /* Free frame buffers */

  camera_framebuf_free();

  syslog(LOG_INFO, "[camera] Stopped — MCLK off, power off, pins restored\n");
  return 0;
}

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: bk7258_camera_buf
 *   Phase 1 Step 3: init PSRAM, allocate two frame buffers, write test
 *   pattern to buf[0], sampled readback verify.
 ****************************************************************************/

int bk7258_camera_buf(void)
{
  int ret, i;
  volatile uint8_t *buf;

  ret = camera_framebuf_alloc();
  if (ret < 0) return ret;

  /* Write test pattern to buf[0] */

  buf = g_camera_buf[0];
  for (i = 0; i < CAMERA_FRAME_SIZE; i++)
    {
      buf[i] = (uint8_t)(i & 0xFF);
    }

  /* Readback verify:
   *   - First 256 bytes: full check
   *   - Last 256 bytes: full check
   *   - Every 1024 bytes: sampled check
   */

  for (i = 0; i < CAMERA_FRAME_SIZE; i++)
    {
      bool check = false;

      if (i < 256)                              check = true;
      else if (i >= CAMERA_FRAME_SIZE - 256)    check = true;
      else if ((i & 1023) == 0)                 check = true;

      if (check && buf[i] != (uint8_t)(i & 0xFF))
        {
          syslog(LOG_ERR,
                 "[camera] Framebuf[%d] mismatch: 0x%02X vs 0x%02X\n",
                 i, buf[i], (uint8_t)(i & 0xFF));
          return -EIO;
        }
    }

  syslog(LOG_INFO,
         "[camera] Framebuf verify OK (%d bytes, buf0=0x%08lX)\n",
         CAMERA_FRAME_SIZE, (unsigned long)g_camera_buf[0]);

  return 0;
}

 * Name: bk7258_camera_dvp_active

 *   configured.  Used by lcdtest for mutual exclusion.
 ****************************************************************************/

bool bk7258_camera_dvp_active(void)
{
  return g_dvp_pins_configed;
}

This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   The conversation covers two tasks:
   
   **Task 1 (Completed):** Add lcdtest↔DVP mutual exclusion in bk7258_gc9d01.c. The user pointed out that bk7258_camera_dvp_active() was exported but never called, so lcdtest scan/pwr/go commands could still run while DVP pins were in use. The fix adds `#ifdef CONFIG_EXAMPLES_GC2145_ID` guarded calls to `bk7258_camera_dvp_active()` at the entry of lcdtest_scan(), lcdtest_pwr(), and lcdtest_go(), returning -EBUSY with a clear error message.

   **Task 2 (In Progress):** Implement Phase 1 Round 2 — DVP controller + DMA single frame capture (Step 4 only). This includes:
   - Step 4a: DVP controller configuration + VSYNC/HSYNC interrupt counting (camera sync)
   - Step 4b: DMA single frame capture to PSRAM (camera grab)
   - New subcommands: `camera sync` and `camera grab`
   - Kconfig items for PCLK/HSYNC/VSYNC polarity inversion
   - Comprehensive error handling and cleanup
   - NOT implementing Steps 5-7 (continuous capture, display, JPEG)

   **Explicit prohibitions:**
   - No burning, JTAG, OpenOCD, lcdtest scan commands
   - No hardware execution of camera sync/grab
   - No steps 5-7 (continuous capture, display, JPEG)
   - No Linux GPL-2.0 code
   - Must use field-level RMW for all shared registers
   - All modified registers must be saved and restored
   - Interrupts must be detached in all failure paths

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - BK7258 SoC: ARM Cortex-M33, GPIO P0-P55
   - YUV_BUF (CIS controller): base at 0x48020000, controls DVP camera interface
   - Register structure (yuv_buf_hw_t): ctrl, pixel, em_base_addr, int_en, int_status
   - CTRL register fields: yuv_mode, yuv_fmt_sel, vck_edge (PCLK edge), hsync_rev, vsync_rev, mclk_div
   - Pixel register: x_pixel[0:7] (width/8), y_pixel[8:15] (height/8), frame_blk[16:31]
   - Interrupts: vsync_nege_int (VSYNC falling edge), yuv_arv_int (YUV arrived/frame done)
   - em_base_addr: external memory base address for frame buffer output
   - DMA: ARMino uses bk_fixed_dma_alloc(DMA_DEV_DTCM, DMA_ID_8) for YUV mode
   - PSRAM: base at 0x60000000, 16MB actual capacity
   - Frame buffer: 640×480×2 = 614400 bytes per frame (RGB565)
   - NuttX build: cmake with absolute BOARD_CONFIG path, toolchain in PATH
   - Repack: python3 vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-devkit/tools/repack.py

3. Files and Code Sections:

   - **`vendor/openvela/boards/contest2026_098_board/src/bk7258_gc9d01.c`** (lcdtest driver)
     - Added DVP mutual exclusion to lcdtest_scan, lcdtest_pwr, lcdtest_go
     - Added conditional include:
     ```c
     #ifdef CONFIG_EXAMPLES_GC2145_ID
     #  include <arch/board/bk7258_camera.h>
     #endif
     ```
     - Added check at entry of each protected function:
     ```c
     #ifdef CONFIG_EXAMPLES_GC2145_ID
       if (bk7258_camera_dvp_active())
         {
           syslog(LOG_ERR,
                  "[lcdtest] refused: DVP pins P29-P39 are in use, "
                  "run 'camera stop' first\n");
           return -EBUSY;
         }
     #endif
     ```

   - **`apps/examples/gc2145_id/camera_main.c`** (build target for camera app)
     - Changed include from `"bk7258_camera.h"` to `<arch/board/bk7258_camera.h>`

   - **`vendor/openvela/boards/contest2026_098_board/include/bk7258_camera.h`**
     - Copied from src/ to include/ directory for proper include path resolution

   - **`claude_phase1_r1.txt`** (report)
     - Updated with lcdtest mutual exclusion details and new build stats

   - **ARMino reference files read (not modified):**
     - `armino/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_dvp/src/bk_dvp.c` — DVP driver, uses HAL abstractions
     - `armino/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/yuv_buf_struct.h` — CIS controller register structure:
       ```c
       typedef volatile struct {
         uint32_t dev_id;      // REG_0x00
         uint32_t dev_version; // REG_0x01
         union { struct { uint32_t soft_reset:1; clk_gate_bypass:1; ...}; uint32_t v; } global_ctrl; // REG_0x02
         uint32_t dev_status;  // REG_0x03
         union { struct { uint32_t yuv_mode:1; ...; vck_edge:1; hsync_rev:1; vsync_rev:1; ...; mclk_div:2; ...}; uint32_t v; } ctrl; // REG_0x04
         union { struct { uint32_t x_pixel:8; y_pixel:8; frame_blk:16; }; uint32_t v; } pixel; // REG_0x05
         // ... partial offsets at 0x06, 0x07
         uint32_t em_base_addr; // REG_0x08
         union { ... } int_en;  // REG_0x09
         union { ... } int_status; // REG_0x0a
       } yuv_buf_hw_t;
       ```
     - `armino/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/yuv_buf_reg.h` — Register offsets
     - Base address: SOC_YUV_BUF_REG_BASE = 0x48020000 + SOC_ADDR_OFFSET (SOC_ADDR_OFFSET = 0)

     - New functions: dvp_ctrl_config(), dvp_ctrl_deconfig(), dvp_irq_attach(), dvp_irq_detach()

/* CIS Controller (YUV_BUF) Register Base Address
 * From ARMino yuv_buf_reg.h: SOC_YUV_BUF_REG_BASE = 0x48020000
 * SOC_ADDR_OFFSET = 0 for non-secure world.
 */

#define YUV_BUF_REG_BASE          0x48020000u

/* Register offsets (word-addressed, multiply by 4 for byte offset) */

#define YUV_BUF_REG_0x04          (YUV_BUF_REG_BASE + 0x04 * 4)  /* CTRL */
#define YUV_BUF_REG_0x05          (YUV_BUF_REG_BASE + 0x05 * 4)  /* PIXEL */
#define YUV_BUF_REG_0x08          (YUV_BUF_REG_BASE + 0x08 * 4)  /* EM_BASE_ADDR */
#define YUV_BUF_REG_0x09          (YUV_BUF_REG_BASE + 0x09 * 4)  /* INT_EN */
#define YUV_BUF_REG_0x0a          (YUV_BUF_REG_BASE + 0x0a * 4)  /* INT_STATUS */

/* CTRL register (0x04) bit fields */

#define YUV_BUF_CTRL_YUV_MODE     (1u << 0)   /* bit[0]: 1=YUV buf mode */
#define YUV_BUF_CTRL_FMT_SEL_MASK 0x6u        /* bit[2:1]: YUV format */
#define YUV_BUF_CTRL_FMT_YUYV     (0u << 1)   /* 00=YUYV */
#define YUV_BUF_CTRL_FMT_UYVY     (1u << 1)   /* 01=UYVY */
#define YUV_BUF_CTRL_FMT_YYUV     (2u << 1)   /* 10=YYUV */
#define YUV_BUF_CTRL_FMT_UVYY     (3u << 1)   /* 11=UVYY */
#define YUV_BUF_CTRL_H264_MODE    (1u << 3)   /* bit[3] */
#define YUV_BUF_CTRL_MCLK_HOLD    (1u << 4)   /* bit[4] */
#define YUV_BUF_CTRL_VCK_EDGE     (1u << 5)   /* bit[5]: PCLK edge */
#define YUV_BUF_CTRL_HSYNC_REV    (1u << 6)   /* bit[6]: invert HSYNC */
#define YUV_BUF_CTRL_VSYNC_REV    (1u << 7)   /* bit[7]: invert VSYNC */
#define YUV_BUF_CTRL_SOI_HSYNC    (1u << 8)   /* bit[8] */
#define YUV_BUF_CTRL_BPS_CIS      (1u << 9)   /* bit[9] */
#define YUV_BUF_CTRL_MEMREV       (1u << 10)  /* bit[10] */
#define YUV_BUF_CTRL_BYTE_REV     (1u << 11)  /* bit[11] */
#define YUV_BUF_CTRL_JPEG_WRD_REV (1u << 12)  /* bit[12] */
#define YUV_BUF_CTRL_PARTIAL_EN   (1u << 13)  /* bit[13] */
#define YUV_BUF_CTRL_SYNC_EDGE    (1u << 14)  /* bit[14] */
#define YUV_BUF_CTRL_MCLK_DIV_MASK 0x30000u   /* bit[17:16] */
#define YUV_BUF_CTRL_MCLK_DIV_POS  16

/* PIXEL register (0x05) bit fields */

#define YUV_BUF_PIXEL_X_MASK      0xFFu       /* bit[7:0]: x_pixel (width/8) */
#define YUV_BUF_PIXEL_Y_MASK      0xFF00u     /* bit[15:8]: y_pixel (height/8) */
#define YUV_BUF_PIXEL_Y_POS       8
#define YUV_BUF_PIXEL_BLK_MASK    0xFFFF0000u /* bit[31:16]: frame_blk */
#define YUV_BUF_PIXEL_BLK_POS     16

/* INT_EN register (0x09) bit fields */

#define YUV_BUF_INT_VSYNC_NEGE    (1u << 0)   /* VSYNC falling edge */
#define YUV_BUF_INT_YUV_ARV       (1u << 1)   /* YUV arrived (frame done) */
#define YUV_BUF_INT_SM0_WR        (1u << 2)   /* SM0 write */
#define YUV_BUF_INT_SM1_WR        (1u << 3)   /* SM1 write */
#define YUV_BUF_INT_FIFO_FULL     (1u << 4)   /* FIFO full */
#define YUV_BUF_INT_ENC_LINE_DONE (1u << 5)   /* encode line done */
#define YUV_BUF_INT_RES_ERR       (1u << 6)   /* resolution error */
#define YUV_BUF_INT_H264_ERR      (1u << 7)   /* H264 error */
#define YUV_BUF_INT_ENC_SLOW      (1u << 8)   /* encode slow */

/* INT_STATUS register (0x0a) — same bit layout as INT_EN */

#define YUV_BUF_INT_STATUS_MASK   0x1FFu      /* bits[8:0] */

#define BK7258_IRQ_YUV_BUF        (BK7258_IRQ_EXTINT + 58)
